item.title: India's Elevate Campuses drops in trading debut after $219 million IPO
item.description: Indian student housing firm Elevate Campuses dropped 1.9% in its stock market debut on Wednesday, following a $219 million initial public offering last week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian student housing firm Elevate Campuses dropped 1.9% in its stock market debut on Wednesday, following a $219 million initial public offering last week. The stock listed at 355.10 rupees on the National Stock Exchange of India, a 1.9% discount to its issue price of 362 rupees per share.

item.title: Thai August factory output rises 4.44% y/y, beats forecast
item.description: Thailand's manufacturing production index rose 4.44% in August from a year earlier, the industry ministry said on Wednesday, stronger than analysts' forecasts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Thailand's manufacturing production index (THMPI=ECI) rose 4.44% in August from a year earlier, the industry ministry said on Wednesday, stronger than analysts' forecasts. The August reading compared with a forecast increase of 1.0% in a Reuters poll. The ministry has revised its MPI methodology, adding new electronics products and changing the weightings to support the country's new economic structure, Supakit Boonsiri, head of the ministry's industrial economics office, told a briefing. The August MPI was boosted by higher electronic output, government stimulus measures, and a weaker baht , he said.

item.title: 金融リスクの連関強まる、監督の国際協力困難に＝バーゼル委議長
item.description:
Phoebe Seers
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 銀行規制の国際基準を策定するバーゼル銀行監督委員会のテ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
金融リスクの連関強まる、監督の国際協力困難に＝バーゼル委議長 13:20 配信

記者会見するバーゼル銀行監督委員会のテデーン議長。2025年1月29日撮影　 TT News Agency/Claudio Bresciani via REUTERS

Phoebe Seers

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 銀行規制の国際基準を策定するバーゼル銀行監督委員会のテデーン議長は３０日、金融リスクの相互関連が強まる中、銀行監督当局間の国際協力は難しさを増しているとの認識を示した。

監督体制が分断されれば、複数の国・地域にまたがるリスクの把握や管理が難しくなる恐れがあると警告した。また中央銀行の独立性が重要だとも強調した。

「地政学的な緊張が見通しを一段と不透明にしている」と述べた。

こうした緊張により、人工知能（ＡＩ）に伴うリスクから将来の金融危機への対応まで、監督当局や関係機関が今後どこまで連携できるのか、既に疑問が生じていると指摘した。

テデーン氏はバリ島で開かれた第２４回銀行監督者国際会議で演説し、「監督体制の分断は、最終的には金融の分断を招く。情報の空白が広がり、規制の違いを利用する機会が増える。国境を越えるリスクの把握や管理も難しくなる」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：日米欧9月同時利上げ、浮き彫りになった「日銀の弱点」＝上野泰也氏 アングル：演出先行の米中会談、トランプ氏むなしい厚遇　習氏は譲歩せず存在感 アングル：インド、学校周辺でのジャンクフード販売規制へ　業界反発と実効性の壁 アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ 最終更新: 9/30(水) 13:20 ロイター

item.title: アングル：ネタニヤフ氏、旧来の選挙戦術で「守護者」演出 ハマス攻撃で信頼回復に苦戦も
item.description:
Maayan Lubell
[エルサレム ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maayan Lubell

[エルサレム ２９日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相（７６）は１０月の総選挙を控え、敵対勢力に囲まれた地域で国民の安全を守れるのは自分だけだと訴えている。長年用いてきた選挙戦術だ。

しかし、２０２３年１０月のイスラム組織ハマスによる大規模攻撃で安全保障上の失態が露呈し、信頼回復に苦戦している。

ネタニヤフ氏が率いる右派政党リクードは「ネタニヤフは屈しない」との公式スローガンを掲げているが、多くの世論調査によるとリクードは議席の約３分の１を失う見通しだ。

演説や選挙活動の短編動画で、ネタニヤフ氏は政敵を、イスラエルの敵と戦う決意も、外国からの批判に立ち向かう気骨も欠いた弱腰な左派だと非難している。

空軍基地で２９日に撮影された動画で、ネタニヤフ氏はイスラエルの敵が総選挙前に攻撃を計画している兆候があるとして、「われわれに手を出すな。今も、これからもだ」と語り、「われわれの長い腕はお前たちに届く」と警告した。

一方、ネタニヤフ氏はこの数週間、中東のパートナー国からハマスによる攻撃の可能性を事前に警告されていたとの報道を否定する対応に追われた。政敵らはこの疑惑を攻撃材料にしてきた。

超党派のシンクタンク、イスラエル民主主義研究所（ＩＤＩ）のヨハナン・プレスナー所長は「これは前例のない事態だ。ネタニヤフ氏はこれまでも総選挙に出馬してきたものの、これほど劇的な安全保障上の失敗を招いた後に立候補したことは一度もない」とし、「選挙は多くの点で現職首相に対する信任投票であり、失敗に対するネタニヤフ氏の責任、政府の責任、そしてイスラエルの対応のあり方が問われる」と訴えた。

＜ネタニヤフ氏、国際社会に対抗姿勢＞

ハマスの攻撃は複数の戦線にまたがる戦闘を引き起こし、イスラエル軍はハマスや、その同盟勢力であるヒズボラ、イランに対して一定の成果を上げたものの、戦略的な成果はほとんど得られなかった。ネタニヤフ氏は、この紛争が地域を変革し、今後も変革し続けると主張している。

しかし、イスラエルのガザでの軍事作戦では数万人のパレスチナ人が死亡し、同地区の大部分が廃墟と化した。こうした状況は外交的な孤立をさらに深める結果となった。

最も重要な同盟国である米国でも、イスラエルへの支持は低下している。

ネタニヤフ氏が前回選挙戦を繰り広げた１９年には、選挙用看板に同氏とトランプ米大統領が握手する姿が使われた。今回のリクードの選挙戦の動画からはトランプ氏の姿が消えている。

とはいえ、１９９６年に初めて首相に選ばれたネタニヤフ氏は、その後、間を置きながらもイスラエルの首相として通算在任期間が最長となっている。

ネタニヤフ氏に近い情報筋によると、ネタニヤフ氏はあらゆる選挙で負けるかもしれないという背水の陣で臨んでおり、それが不利な状況でもしばしば勝利を収めてきた一因になっている。

選挙活動に詳しい別の情報筋は、世論調査の結果にもかかわらずネタニヤフ氏の陣営は結束を保っており、動揺や混乱の兆候は見られないと指摘する。

ネタニヤフ氏は２４日の国連演説でイスラエルの行動を強く擁護し、批判国を非難した。この演説は通信アプリ「テレグラム」の同氏のアカウントでも大きく取り上げられ、演説前には６本の予告動画を投稿した。

うち１本では「世界に向けて皆様を代表できることを誇りに思う。今まさに（演壇に）上がり、国連に対してイスラエルのために戦うところだ」と訴え、さらに演説内容の抜粋を５本公開した。

演説全文へのリンクには、ヘブライ語で「ネタニヤフが世界に立ち向かう」という説明文が付けられていた。

＜最終局面は膠着状態か＞

ネタニヤフ氏の選挙活動でのもう一つの常とう手段は、政敵が勝利すれば、パレスチナ人に融和的で安全保障を損なうアラブ系政党と連立政権を組むことになるとして、有権者の不安をあおる手法だ。

ネタニヤフ氏の主な対抗馬は、中道政党ヤシャル（「まっすぐ」の意味）のアイゼンコット党首だ。元軍トップのアイゼンコット氏はガザでの戦闘で息子を亡くした。

リクードは２６日以降、人工知能（ＡＩ）で生成したものを含め、アイゼンコット氏がアラブ系政党の指導者らと並ぶ画像を少なくとも４回投稿している。

ネタニヤフ氏は９月１８日の選挙動画で「『まっすぐ』など存在しない。ヤシャルははったりだ。左か右かのどちらかだ。それが今回の選挙の本質だ。パレスチナ国家を望むのか。それとも、ユダヤ国家を望むのか」と訴えた。

しかし、シャローム・ハートマン研究所の政治アナリスト、アモツ・アサエル氏は、アイゼンコット氏の安全保障分野での経歴や、ヤシャルの候補者らの顔ぶれを考慮すると、ネタニヤフ氏がアイゼンコット氏に対して使い慣れた戦術を用いるのは成功の見込みが薄いかもしれないと指摘する。

世論調査はしばしば不正確だが、ネタニヤフ氏は、総選挙後に過半数の議席を確保し、政権を維持する可能性は低いと認識しているとされる。

アサエル氏は「ネタニヤフ氏の戦略は、代わりとなる政権の樹立を阻止するのに十分な票を獲得し、何らかの膠着（こうちゃく）状態を作り出し、次の選挙に向けて暫定首相の座にとどまることにあるようだ」との見方を示した。

item.title: 五輪＝28年ロサンゼルス大会の聖火リレー、全米50州を巡回
item.description: ［アトランタ ２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［アトランタ　２９日　ロイター］ - ２０２８年ロサンゼルス五輪の組織委員会は２９日、米国内の聖火リレーは１９９６年夏季大会開催地のアトランタから出発し、米国の全５０州を巡る予定だと発表した。

組織委員会のケイシー・ワッサーマン会長は、アトランタ市庁舎でアンドレ・ディケンズ市長らと共に会見。「全ての五輪は一つの炎から始まる。その炎をロサンゼルスへ運ぶことは、全米で分かち合うべき栄誉であり特権だ」と話した。組織委はロス五輪に先立ち、全米のコミュニティーをつなぐことを目指していると述べている。

聖火リレーのスケジュールや全ルートは２７年に発表予定。リレーの期間やランナー選定の方法は、明らかにされていない。

２８年ロス五輪の閉幕後、パラリンピックの聖火リレーも行われるが、その出発地は後日発表の予定。ロサンゼルスは１９３２年と８４年に続く３回目の夏季五輪開催で、パラリンピックは今回が初となる。

item.title: China adds 55% tariff to Brazil beef imports
item.description: China will collect an additional 55% tariff on beef imports from Brazil beginning on October 1, on top of the current applicable rate, the Chinese commerce ministry said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Daphne Zhang, Liz Lee
item.content:encoded: China will collect an additional 55% tariff on beef imports from Brazil beginning on October 1, on top of the current applicable rate, the Chinese commerce ministry said on Wednesday. China in January said it would impose an added 55% tariff on beef imports that exceed quota levels from key suppliers, including Brazil, in a move to protect its domestic cattle industry. China, the largest buyer of Brazilian beef, established a 1.1 million metric ton quota for Brazil this year. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said last week that [USN:L1N45D0NZ TEXT:"Uruguay had authorized Brazil"] to use the surplus from its beef export quota to China. But China has not agreed to allow Brazil to use Uruguay's export quota this year or next year, according to industry insiders. Industry insiders have told Reuters that even if Brazil directly reaches an agreement with other countries over their unused beef export volumes, China is unlikely to agree to it. Reuters reported in May that Beijing had rejected [USN:L4N41W0QX TEXT:"Brazil's repeated lobbying China"] to relax and reallocate the quotas to allow Brazil to use other countries' extra export volumes. China's Commerce Ministry has not publicly commented on Brazil's requests. All eyes are on whether China will renew its beef export quota system for 2027 by year-end. Brazil's total beef export volumes [USN:L6N43I12P TEXT:"are expected to drop 10%"] year-on-year in 2026, industry group Abiec estimated earlier this year, amid restrictions imposed by Beijing and a recent curb on Brazilian meat exports to the European Union.

item.title: China says Taiwan is 'desecrating the martyrs' with its World War Two history criticism
item.description: China's government on Wednesday accused Taiwan of "desecrating the martyrs" with its criticism of Beijing's interpretation of World War Two, saying that to question the narrative over the conflict was a betrayal of history.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's government on Wednesday accused Taiwan of "desecrating the martyrs" with its criticism of Beijing's interpretation of World War Two, saying that to question the narrative over the conflict was a betrayal of history. China takes the legacy of the war, in which millions of Chinese died during the Japanese invasion, very seriously. Both Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump last week talked up their countries' alliance at the time. But Taipei says Beijing is lauding the [USN:L4N45J003 TEXT:"wrong China"], given the government at the time was the Republic of China which fought with the allies, not today's People's Republic of China. The Republic of China government fled to Taiwan in 1949 after losing a civil war and that remains its formal name. Speaking at a weekly news briefing in Beijing, Zhang Han, a spokeswoman for China's Taiwan Affairs Office, said Taiwan's ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) was trying to distort World War Two history. "This is a betrayal of history, a desecration of the martyrs, and a betrayal of the nation," she added. Beijing says that during the war, communist guerrilla forces acted as the backbone of the fighting in China, and its official history gives mainly passing mention of the Republican forces. Zhang said the forces of the Kuomintang fought Japan on the main battlefield - the then-ruling party in China and these days Taiwan's largest opposition party - with the communists "opening vast rear battlefields behind enemy lines". "The victory in the war of resistance was the victory of the entire nation and also an important component of the world anti-fascist war's victory, deserving of joint commemoration and remembrance by compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait," she said. Taiwan was a Japanese colony from 1895 to 1945 and at the end of the war was handed over to the Republic of China government, which ruled under martial until 1987. The victory in the war and Taiwan's recovery are a "shared glory of the Chinese people and the Chinese nation", Zhang added. The DPP traditionally espouses Taiwan's separate identity and history from China, and rejects Beijing's territorial claim. China refuses to speak to Taiwan President Lai Ching-te, saying he is a "separatist".

item.title: After delivering babies, Ozawa aims to deliver for Japan in padel debut
item.description: The transition from a busy hospital to the international court may surprise others, but Japan's padel pioneer Kotomi Ozawa finds a striking resemblance between the pressure of elite sport and her previous career — as a midwife.
item.dc:creator: Amlan Chakraborty
item.content:encoded: The transition from a busy hospital to the international court may surprise others, but Japan's padel pioneer Kotomi Ozawa finds a striking resemblance between the pressure of elite sport and her previous career — as a midwife. As padel makes its Asian Games debut, the former Keio University Hospital practitioner is leading the charge for the continent, relying on the composure she honed inside Tokyo's high-pressure delivery rooms until four years ago. "Of course, it's a very different job, but physically, midwifery is also very tough. You have to be strong," she said. "Mentally, you have to support families and babies in their most difficult times. That experience helps me a lot on the court. Even when I have a big match, it makes me feel calmer." Whenever the stakes are high and pressure builds, the line between her two callings often blurs. "When you deliver babies, there is so much tension, and you have to help the mother make quick decisions," Ozawa said. "You have to hear the heartbeat and use all five senses to monitor everything. It helps me in a similar way when I am on the court. You have to use all your senses." Trading the ward for the court was a daunting gamble for Ozawa, given that Europe and South America remain the traditional epicentres of the sport — a fast-paced hybrid of tennis and squash. "It was a tough journey as we had to fly to Europe or South America to train – and I loved my old job – but there are not many people here (in Asia) doing padel as a career," she said. "I wanted to try it, even if it was challenging, to build a pathway for the next generation." That gamble is already paying dividends, with the 28-year-old and her partner Chifumi Sato advancing to the women's pairs quarter-finals. Yet, while her immediate focus remains on securing silverware on the court, Ozawa has not ruled out an eventual return to healthcare. "One of my dreams is to combine healthcare with sport," she said. "I love kids and looking after families, and I think sport helps communities a lot. It would be amazing to do them both again."

item.title: United States captain Ream retires from international football
item.description: United States captain Tim Ream, 38, retired from international football on Tuesday, having earned 86 caps and won two CONCACAF Nations League titles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: United States captain Tim Ream, 38, retired from international football on Tuesday, having earned 86 caps and won two CONCACAF Nations League titles. Charlotte FC defender Ream captained the US side at this year's World Cup on home soil, where they reached the last 16 before being eliminated by Belgium. "That's it for me. I'm proud of being part of something for 16 years, but it is time to step away from the national team," the former Fulham and Bolton Wanderers player told reporters ahead of a friendly match against Chile in his hometown of St. Louis, Missouri. The US, who beat Chile 4-2, next play Mexico in Glendale, Arizona, on Saturday before hosting Canada in St. Paul, Minnesota, on October 6.

item.title: 「人類滅亡」警告しつつIPOへ突き進む米アンソロピック、AI規制不在のまま評価額2兆ドル目指す
item.description:
対話型人工知能（AI）の「クロード」を手掛ける米アンソロピックは、生成AIの安全対策の枠組みが未整備な中、中間選挙後に評価額2兆ドルの史上最大規模の新規株式公開（IPO）を目指しているとみられる。同社はIPOの目論見書において、AIが「人類に壊滅的な被害や存亡に関わるリスク」をもたらす可能性があると投資家に警告。ライバルのオープンAIがIPOを延期する一方、規制に否定的なトランプ大統領とCEOの協議が続いており、政府の関与と企業の動向に注目する必要がある。
ロイター編集 マイク・ドーラン
かなり深刻な状況だ。AIの危険性を警告しておきながら、なぜ新規株式公開（IPO）を進めるのか、疑問が残るのも無理はない。規制や安全対策を整備する広範な議論が常に行われる中で、適切な枠組みはまだ整っていない。
現状、アンソロピックは中間選挙の直後、あるいはその少し後にIPOを実施する見込みだ。最大のライバルであるオープンAIはIPOを来年ま
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
対話型人工知能（AI）の「クロード」を手掛ける米アンソロピックは、生成AIの安全対策の枠組みが未整備な中、中間選挙後に評価額2兆ドルの史上最大規模の新規株式公開（IPO）を目指しているとみられる。同社はIPOの目論見書において、AIが「人類に壊滅的な被害や存亡に関わるリスク」をもたらす可能性があると投資家に警告。ライバルのオープンAIがIPOを延期する一方、規制に否定的なトランプ大統領とCEOの協議が続いており、政府の関与と企業の動向に注目する必要がある。

ロイター編集　マイク・ドーラン

かなり深刻な状況だ。AIの危険性を警告しておきながら、なぜ新規株式公開（IPO）を進めるのか、疑問が残るのも無理はない。規制や安全対策を整備する広範な議論が常に行われる中で、適切な枠組みはまだ整っていない。

現状、アンソロピックは中間選挙の直後、あるいはその少し後にIPOを実施する見込みだ。最大のライバルであるオープンAIはIPOを来年まで延期している。そのため、いつ実施できるかという課題が浮上している。評価額2兆ドルを目指しており、実現すれば史上最大のIPOとなる。

水面下では対話が続いている。アンソロピックCEOのダリオ・アモデイ氏とトランプ米大統領による昨夜の会談も含め、27日にも行われていた協議の内容が注目される。トランプ氏はAIモデルへの新規規制を望まない姿勢を明示している。米国政府は何らかの形でIPOに関与しようとしているのか、政府は何を意図しているのか。より重要なのは、アンソロピックがどう回答しているかだ。

item.title: Desempleados en EE.UU. están tardando más en encontrar trabajo pese al crecimiento de la economía
item.description: El tiempo promedio para encontrar trabajo en EE.UU. superó recientemente los seis meses, mientras casi dos millones de personas llevan al menos 27 semanas buscando empleo.
item.dc:creator: Jeffrey Sparshott, Maria Eloisa Capurro
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Más allá de la baja tasa de desempleo que se observa en Estados Unidos, el número de personas que se enfrentan a períodos prolongados de desempleo está aumentando. Esta dinámica constituye una anomalía en el estable mercado laboral actual. El tiempo medio que se tarda en encontrar un empleo ha superado recientemente los seis meses, el periodo más largo desde mediados de la década de 2010, si se excluye la época de la pandemia, y el consiguiente aumento del desempleo de larga duración no tiene precedentes fuera de los periodos de recesión. Ver más: Solicitudes de subsidio por desempleo en EE.UU. caen a una de sus cifras más bajas desde 1969 Mientras los responsables de los bancos centrales se centran en combatir la inflación persistente, los casi dos millones de estadounidenses que llevan 27 semanas o más buscando trabajo, lo que se define como desempleo de larga duración, se están quedando atrás. “A los trabajadores les resulta realmente difícil incorporarse o reincorporarse al mercado laboral”, afirmó Elise Gould, economista sénior del Economic Policy Institute, con sede en Washington. Las búsquedas de empleo prolongadas suelen afectar a los trabajadores de oficina, que no están acostumbrados a permanecer al margen, y a los jóvenes que se encuentran al inicio de su carrera profesional. Para quienes se ven excluidos del empleo durante períodos prolongados, la pérdida de competencias y el deterioro de las redes profesionales agravan la presión financiera derivada del aumento de los precios y de los costos de financiación. Al mismo tiempo, la economía, por lo demás sólida, elimina cualquier sensación de urgencia por ampliar las medidas de apoyo, como reforzar una red de seguridad en la que, por lo general, las prestaciones por desempleo se agotan al cabo de seis meses. Los economistas estiman que la tasa de desempleo se mantuvo en el 4,1% en el informe de empleo de septiembre, que se publicará este viernes. A los responsables de la Reserva Federal les preocupa más la inflación que el mercado laboral, y este mes subieron las tasas de interés por primera vez desde 2023. Los inversores esperan al menos una subida más este año. Ver más: América Latina reduce el desempleo juvenil, pero la OIT advierte qué hay detrás de la caída “Un ciclo de subidas de tasas de interés va a complicar la situación de los desempleados de larga duración”, afirmó Claudia Sahm, economista jefe de New Century Advisors LLC y antigua miembro del personal de la Reserva Federal. Incluso sin despidos generalizados, las tasas de interés más altas reducirán aún más los incentivos de las empresas para crear nuevos puestos de trabajo, señaló, lo que frenará las tasas de contratación que, a principios de este año, se situaron en los niveles más bajos desde 2010. Darlene Ferris es una de las personas que tienen dificultades para encontrar trabajo. Tras perder su empleo en Philips en enero, esta residente de Connecticut se sometió a múltiples rondas de entrevistas, comenzó un programa de becas que ayuda a los profesionales del sector empresarial a dar el salto al sector sin ánimo de lucro y se inscribió en un programa de apoyo a las mujeres emprendedoras. “Llevo seis meses trabajando sin descanso casi todos los días de la semana en esto e intentando que algo salga adelante, y aunque resulta muy desalentador, no tengo tiempo para darle vueltas al asunto”, afirmó. “Pero estoy muy preocupada y no sé cómo va a acabar todo esto”. Ferris señaló que la búsqueda de empleo es notablemente diferente a la de hace cinco años, cuando consiguió el puesto en Philips. En esta ocasión, se enfrenta a más ofertas sin salida y a sistemas de seguimiento de candidatos que plantean sus propios retos. En un momento dado, recibió un correo electrónico automático en el que se le agradecía haber asistido a una entrevista de trabajo para la que nunca se le había ofrecido el puesto. También se ha encontrado con empresas reacias a seguir adelante ahora que ha cumplido los 50 años. “Es un momento difícil, pero sigo teniendo esperanza”, afirmó. “Sé que cuento con grandes habilidades y experiencia, y solo necesito esa oportunidad”. Ver más: Desempleo en Argentina alcanzó el 7,9% en el segundo trimestre 2026: crece 0,3 puntos en un año Tras advertir el año pasado sobre las debilidades subyacentes del mercado laboral, la Reserva Federal ha cambiado su enfoque hacia la inflación. Beth Hammack, de la Fed de Cleveland, definió la semana pasada el mercado laboral como cercano al pleno empleo, mientras que John Williams, de la Fed de Nueva York, lo calificó de “prácticamente” en equilibrio. “En conjunto, nos encontramos más o menos en una situación de pleno empleo”, declaró el presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, durante una rueda de prensa a mediados de septiembre. No obstante, algunos responsables políticos han señalado las consecuencias duraderas de un entorno caracterizado por un bajo nivel de contrataciones y despidos, lo que podría desanimar a determinados trabajadores. Son múltiples los factores que están provocando que la búsqueda de empleo se prolongue. Los empleadores se muestran cautelosos a la hora de contratar tras la oleada de contrataciones posterior a la pandemia, que condujo a un exceso de personal. Los trabajadores se muestran cautelosos a la hora de dejar sus puestos de trabajo debido a que hay menos ofertas de empleo. Y la inteligencia artificial está modificando o sustituyendo ciertas tareas. Una investigación realizada por las economistas de la Fed de Richmond, Katarína Borovičková y Claudia Macaluso, reveló una caída desproporcionadamente grande en la tasa de inserción laboral de las personas que suelen ocupar puestos estables y de larga duración, en un grado nunca visto en ninguna recesión anterior, y mucho menos durante una fase de expansión como la actual. “Sea cual sea el motivo por el que resulta más difícil encontrar un nuevo empleo en el periodo actual, está afectando con especial intensidad a los trabajadores más comprometidos con su puesto”, escribieron las economistas. Las tasas de inserción laboral cayeron con mayor intensidad en las profesiones con mayor exposición a la inteligencia artificial, según constataron las investigadoras. No obstante, la rápida evolución de la tecnología solo explica una pequeña parte del aumento del desempleo de larga duración, señalaron. Ver más: Ofertas de empleo en EE.UU. caen a su nivel más bajo en cinco meses y los despidos siguen moderados Otro posible culpable: el crecimiento del empleo en sectores muy concretos. La asistencia sanitaria y la asistencia social representaron más creación de empleo durante el último año que todas las demás categorías juntas. “Cuando no se produce un crecimiento generalizado, el mercado laboral resulta muy frágil”, afirmó Kory Kantenga, director de economía para las Américas en LinkedIn. “No todo el mundo se beneficia de ese tipo de mercado laboral, ya que no todos podemos dedicarnos a la asistencia sanitaria”. Denise Marsuh logró esa transición, pero no fue un camino fácil. Tras dejar su trabajo de recopilación y análisis de datos para el Departamento de Salud Pública de Connecticut en abril de 2025, no pudo encontrar empleo de inmediato, agotó sus ahorros y fue desalojada de su piso. Esta mujer de 31 años acabó en un centro de acogida de New Haven, donde el personal la ayudó a ponerse en contacto con centros de inserción laboral y de formación. Esto, a su vez, le permitió inscribirse en un programa de formación gratuito para convertirse en auxiliar de enfermería titulada. Marsuh aceptó un puesto de trabajo en una residencia de personas mayores a finales de agosto, poniendo fin a un periodo de desempleo de aproximadamente 16 meses. Ahora está estudiando para convertirse en enfermera titulada. “De lo que me di cuenta es que, especialmente en el sector sanitario, si se cuenta con un certificado, se puede acceder al mercado laboral. La asistencia sanitaria es uno de los sectores en los que resulta más fácil incorporarse una vez que se obtiene la certificación”, afirmó Marsuh. Ver más: Empresas en México adoptan cada vez más la IA, ¿cuáles son los efectos en el empleo? Las prestaciones por desempleo duran hasta medio año para las personas que buscan trabajo de forma regular. Además, existen requisitos laborales para acceder a prestaciones como el Programa de Asistencia Nutricional Suplementaria (SNAP) y Medicaid, y el próximo año entrarán en vigor otros nuevos. “Existe la creencia de que hay muchos puestos de trabajo disponibles, pero eso simplemente no es cierto en muchos mercados laborales locales”, afirmó James Ziliak, director fundador del Centro de Investigación sobre la Pobreza de la Universidad de Kentucky. “En general, en nuestra esfera política se echa mucho de menos un diálogo serio”, añadió. “Eso supone un verdadero problema para el futuro del empleo y para el futuro de las ayudas destinadas a quienes se quedan sin trabajo en este país”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 米国で人型ロボットが清掃サービスの人手不足を補完 「細かい作業には人間が必要」との見方
item.description:
米国でヒューマノイド（人型）ロボットが清掃サービスに導入されつつある。サンフランシスコに拠点を置くTAUロボティクス社は、これまで自動化技術が苦戦してきた領域、すなわち清掃サービスにおいてロボットなら成功を収められると考えている。共同創業者は「人間ができることなら、このロボットにも対応が可能だ」と述べ、「家の掃除を好む人は多くない。そのため雇用の奪い合いではなく、人手不足の穴を埋める存在となる」との期待感を口にした。一方、あるハウスクリーニング会社の最高経営責任者（CEO）は、細やかな作業が求められる場所の清掃について「当面は人間が必要とされるはずだ」と述べ、ロボットと競合することはないとの見方を示した。
TAUロボティクス共同創業者 コルネリア・バインツィール氏 「家の掃除を好む人は多くない。そのため雇用の奪い合いではなく、人手不足の穴を埋める存在となるのだ。
拭き掃除や掃除機掛け、モップ掛け、遠隔操作を加えれば食器の片付
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国でヒューマノイド（人型）ロボットが清掃サービスに導入されつつある。サンフランシスコに拠点を置くTAUロボティクス社は、これまで自動化技術が苦戦してきた領域、すなわち清掃サービスにおいてロボットなら成功を収められると考えている。共同創業者は「人間ができることなら、このロボットにも対応が可能だ」と述べ、「家の掃除を好む人は多くない。そのため雇用の奪い合いではなく、人手不足の穴を埋める存在となる」との期待感を口にした。一方、あるハウスクリーニング会社の最高経営責任者（CEO）は、細やかな作業が求められる場所の清掃について「当面は人間が必要とされるはずだ」と述べ、ロボットと競合することはないとの見方を示した。

TAUロボティクス共同創業者 コルネリア・バインツィール氏 「家の掃除を好む人は多くない。そのため雇用の奪い合いではなく、人手不足の穴を埋める存在となるのだ。

拭き掃除や掃除機掛け、モップ掛け、遠隔操作を加えれば食器の片付けや、ベッドメイクやシーツの交換、トイレ掃除、浴槽の磨き上げなどもこなせる。

できる作業は多岐にわたる。人間ができることなら、このロボットにも対応が可能だ。人間ができることは何でもできる」

サンフランシスコ在住の利用客 ガービット・グプタさん 「キッチンの作業台の清掃を始めた。洗剤の噴射は実に手際が良い。作業後の台は見違えるほどきれいだ。実に素晴らしい手際だった。

浴槽の清掃に関しては、そこまでの仕上がりではなかったが、導入されたばかりの機能だと聞いた。まだ新しい試みだそうなので、評価は保留しておく」

ハウスクリーニング会社CEO バイオレット・オストゥーニ氏 「確かに複雑な心境ではある。興味深く愛らしいが、動作は少し遅い。比較するのは難しい。清掃員は人間だからだ。

ロボットと人間は全くの別物だ。競合関係にあるとは必ずしも言えない。共存できる世界はあると考えている。

例えば……広々とした施設での清掃こそが、ロボットに適した活躍の場かもしれない。空間が広く、開放的な場所であれば、細やかな作業はそれほど求められない。

そうした場所の清掃業務において、人間が担う役割がすぐに消えることはないと確信している。当面は人間が必要とされるはずだ」

item.title: Indian shares set for weak October as foreign investors ramp up shorts, brokerages say
item.description: India's monthly equity derivatives expiry on Tuesday signalled a risk-off turn, marked by broad unwinding of bullish positions, a fresh buildup of shorts and heavier foreign selling, as markets grapple with a global bond rout, brokerages said.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran
item.content:encoded: India's monthly equity derivatives expiry on Tuesday signalled a risk-off turn, marked by broad unwinding of bullish positions, a fresh buildup of shorts and heavier foreign selling, as markets grapple with a global bond rout, brokerages said. The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 6.7% during the September derivative series, making it the worst performer among Asian markets. Bank Nifty (.NSEBANK) declined 5.7%, contributing the most to benchmark losses. October may see a "technical rebound", but not a durable return to risk-on sentiment, said IIFL Capital. IIFL sees scope for a bounce towards 23,300 as Nifty approaches the 22,500 level. However, it cautioned that a sustained break below 22,400 could open the door to more losses. Nuvama Alternative and Quantitative Research sees the benchmark between 22,350 support and 23,400 resistance, despite favourable seasonal trends. The September derivative series saw broad-based selling and heavy bearish bets by overseas investors, Ambit Capital said, as nearly half of futures and options stocks ended with long positions unwound and more than 40% seeing a buildup of shorts. Rollover data from Ambit Capital, IIFL Capital and Nuvama suggest that the bearish positions have been carried into October. Nifty rollovers stood at 74%, in line with the three-month average, while Bank Nifty's 79% rollover was marginally above the average of 78%. Nifty futures' open interest rose nearly 30% from the start of September, which IIFL says suggests "heavy shorts". Foreign institutional investors' net index-futures shorts rose to about 267,000 contracts from 184,000 at the previous expiry, data from Nuvama showed. Overseas investors have sold $2.7 billion of Indian shares in the spot market, a six-month high, pointing to a broad-based selloff. Domestic institutional buying cushioned some of that pressure as retail investors stayed long on stock futures, in a sharp divergence between foreign and domestic positioning, Nuvama said.

item.title: Apple set to sell 6 million iPhone Duos in 2026: Counterpoint Research
item.description: The figure, more typical of niche foldable segment than Apple's usual smartphone sales, is contingent on how well the company ramps up production of the new hardware, Counterpoint senior analyst said ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Vlad Savov Apple Inc. is set to sell about 6 million units of the iPhone Duo this year, Counterpoint Research said, offering the first estimate for how the company’s inaugural foldable device will fare. The figure, more typical of the niche foldable segment than Apple’s usual smartphone sales, is contingent on how well the company ramps up production of the new hardware, Counterpoint senior analyst Ivan Lam said. Priced at $1,999 and set for an October release, the iPhone Duo sits atop the Apple lineup and carries industry-wide hopes for stoking greater interest and sales of foldables. Market researcher IDC estimates foldables will grow 13% to 22.9 million units shipped this year with Apple’s help. Without the iPhone Duo, the segment would have seen a decline, it said. Introduced alongside the Duo this month, Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro family has gotten off to a fast start in China, Counterpoint said. The company’s Pro edition smartphones were for the first time released without a corresponding base-model upgrade, steering consumers looking for an upgrade to the pricier models and helping deliver a 12% rise compared to the iPhone 17 Pro’s initial sales. That performance bucked a broad downtrend in the world’s largest smartphone market, with Chinese brands taking the brunt of a 17% year-on-year decline across this summer, according to the researchers. That helped Apple grab 33% of China’s highly competitive smartphone arena, an unusual feat when companies like Huawei Technologies Co., Oppo, Vivo and Xiaomi Corp. usually have roughly equal shares with Apple. But elevated component costs are forcing all phone makers to raise prices and try to make up the shortfall of unit sales in higher revenue per unit. That works in Apple’s favor by narrowing the cost advantage of its rivals. “Price hikes of over $200 on many Chinese flagship models may have raised the price anchor, strengthening the iPhone’s relative value proposition,” Lam said.

item.title: Astros ask Hunter Brown to square series with White Sox
item.description: HOUSTON -- The Astros spent most of the regular season playing from behind, so their late rally to the American League West title should serve as a template for how they must respond after dropping Game 1 of their American League wild-card series with the Chicago White Sox.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: HOUSTON -- The Astros spent most of the regular season playing from behind, so their late rally to the American League West title should serve as a template for how they must respond after dropping Game 1 of their American League wild-card series with the Chicago White Sox. The White Sox took a 1-0 lead in the best-of-three series with a 6-3 victory on Tuesday, pushing the Astros to the brink of elimination going into Game 2 on Wednesday afternoon. Comebacks are nothing new for the Astros, who were 11 games below .500 on May 20 and six games out of first place in the AL West in early June. "We've got to turn around," said Astros manager Joe Espada. "We've got to get back on track here and get ready for (Wednesday). "The message is clear: we've got to win (Game 2). I don't need to tell them that. They know. Our backs have been against the corner before, and I think that's when we are our best. When we fight back. I really admire how they bounce back, and they react to challenges." Right-hander Hunter Brown (6-4, 3.19 ERA) is scheduled to start Game 2 for the Astros. Brown made 20 starts this season after missing two-plus months with a shoulder injury. He closed the regular season with a flourish, going 3-1 with a 2.33 ERA and 52 strikeouts over his last 38 2/3 innings and seven starts. Brown allowed two earned runs or fewer in six of those appearances. Brown has been particularly brilliant against the White Sox with a 6-0 record and a 2.39 ERA in six career starts. In his pair of appearances against the White Sox during the second half of this season, Brown went 2-0 with a 1.38 ERA and 14 strikeouts across 13 innings. In eight career postseason appearances, including one start, Brown has not recorded a decision while posting a 1.65 ERA and 16 strikeouts in 16 1/3 innings. Right-hander Sean Burke (11-7, 3.34 ERA), the White Sox's most consistent starter this season, gets the ball on Wednesday for his postseason debut. After allowing seven runs on eight hits and two walks while recording only four outs in a 9-3 loss to the Pittsburgh Pirates on Sept. 8, Burke won his final three starts while surrendering three runs (two earned) on 13 hits and six walks with 16 strikeouts over 16 1/3 innings. Burke is 1-2 with a 5.28 ERA in three career starts against the Astros. In two starts against Houston this season, Burke went 1-1 with a 1.54 ERA and 16 strikeouts over 11 2/3 innings. That includes a 4-1 loss when Brown and Burke went head-to-head on July 25 in Chicago. The White Sox, making their first postseason appearance since 2021, seized a 5-0 lead by the middle of the fifth inning in Game 1 to mitigate concerns about their relative inexperience. The White Sox scored in four of their first five innings to stake their claim as a viable threat to advance. "We came here to win the series," said White Sox manager Will Venable. "The first part of that is getting this first win, which is great. These guys believe that they can win series here in the postseason, which showed up in the way they took the field. Strike early with a couple of runs. A bunch of young guys that haven't been in this situation before, they didn't back down at all. "They understand that this is a new season, and it's really a one-game season at a time. We know we have a series; we want to go out and win the series, but it starts with just playing one game." --MK Bower, Field Level Media

item.title: 2年国債入札「無難な結果」の声、応札倍率は過去12カ月平均を上回る
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 財務省が30日に実施した2年利付国債入札は、投資家需要の強弱を反映する応札倍率が3.89倍と、過去12カ月平均（3.75倍）を上回った。利回りの高さから一定の需要があり、波乱なく消化された。市場参加者の間からは「無難な結果だった」との声が出ている。

応札倍率は前回（2.97倍）も上回った。最低落札価格は100円5銭5厘と市場予想（100円5銭5厘）と一致。大きいと入札の不調を示すテール（落札価格の最低と平均の差）は1銭4厘と前回（3銭4厘）を下回った。結果発表を受けて、下落していた長期国債先物12月物は一時前日比で上昇に転じた。新発10年債利回りは0.5ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）高い3.09%で推移している。

SMBC日興証券のSMBC日興証券の田未来シニア金利ストラテジストは、2年債入札は利回りの高さが需要を喚起し無難な結果だったと語る。「市場は日米の金融政策を注視しており、週末に公表される米雇用統計が最大の注目材料だ」と指摘。「内容が強ければ日米とも中期金利主導で金利が上昇し、弱ければ金利低下材料になる」と言う。

原油高によるインフレや各国の財政を巡る懸念を背景に、世界的な債券売りが続いている。グローバルな設備投資需要の強さも加わって利上げ観測が高まり、米国の10年債利回りは29日、一時5.29%を上回り、2007年以来の高水準を付けた。日本の新発2年債利回りは1995年以来の高水準で推移している。

片山さつき財務相は25日のブルームバーグとのインタビューで、高市早苗首相は金融緩和や財政拡張を志向するリフレ派ではないとの見解を示した。城内実経済財政担当相は25日の記者会見で、「アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレーション政策、そういう局面は終わっている」と述べた。

item.title: OpenAI eyes raising $30 billion in funding at $1.4 trillion valuation
item.description: The firm is seeking a valuation of around $1.4 trn, not including the money raised, said the people, potentially vaulting it back above longtime rival Anthropic's most recent private market valuation ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Rebecca Torrence, Ed Ludlow and Shirin Ghaffary OpenAI aims to raise at least $30 billion from investors in a new round of funding, according to people familiar with the matter, after the artificial intelligence startup pushed back its plans for an initial public offering. The company is seeking a valuation of around $1.4 trillion, not including the money raised, said the people, potentially vaulting it back above longtime rival Anthropic’s most recent private market valuation. Bloomberg News previously reported OpenAI was mulling a new round at a $1.2 trillion valuation.  The fundraising discussions are early and could change, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public. The demand for the round is being led by investors, one person said, as the firm sees strong revenue growth. OpenAI declined to comment. The ChatGPT maker has been locked in a heated battle with Anthropic to sign up more business customers and bolster revenue ahead of their planned Wall Street debuts. Both firms have filed confidential paperwork to go public, with Anthropic expected to hold its public listing as soon as this fall.  OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman recently said his firm would refrain from going public this year. In an interview with Bloomberg TV on Tuesday, he said the company wants to navigate a period of heightened artificial intelligence safety concerns without the pressure of being a newly public company. The ChatGPT maker is currently “adjusting” to a “new level” of AI capability and the added safety requirements that coincide with it, Altman said. “We just want to get our feet under us and make sure we understand how to operate in this new way, [and] be able to make some of these decisions in front of us without the pressure of being a newly public company,” Altman said, adding that he believes investors will be “patient” with its IPO planning. The latest fundraise is meant to serve as a bridge round to provide OpenAI with additional capital in place of an IPO, the people said. OpenAI most recently raised $122 billion in March at a $852 billion valuation, including the money.  Like its peers, OpenAI has faced mounting scrutiny over the potential for AI to cause catastrophic harm, including through cybersecurity breaches. OpenAI’s technology has been involved in a number of security incidents, including targeting Australian government websites. The company also said this week it would not release its latest model, GPT-6.1 Astra, because the system didn’t meet its internal safety standards. Altman has endorsed a plan by Anthropic’s Dario Amodei to slow down development of the most cutting-edge AI models and bring on independent evaluators to help safeguard the technology.  At the same time, OpenAI continues to compete aggressively in the increasingly crowded market for AI agents that field more complex tasks for users. At the company’s developer event on Tuesday, OpenAI unveiled a new always-on AI agent called Dots that is poised to compete directly with products like Muse from Meta Platforms Inc.  OpenAI is also shaking up its subscription offerings by debuting a new high-end $500 paid tier with higher usage limits and faster processing speeds, and reducing certain usage limits for its $200 plan. Widely considered to be on the backfoot for much of the year, OpenAI has worked to narrow its product focus and seen renewed momentum for tools that streamline the process of coding, among other work.  OpenAI’s revenue run rate accelerated over the summer and topped $40 billion, Bloomberg News reported in August. The company’s run rate revenue has grown by 70% since July, one person said.

item.title: Cam Schlittler (10 K's), Ben Rice (2 HRs) send Yankees to Game 1 rout
item.description: NEW YORK -- Cam Schlittler fanned 10 in 6 1/3 dominant innings while Ben Rice homered twice and drove in six runs as the New York Yankees pulled away for a 9-0 rout of the Boston Red Sox in Game 1 of an American League wild-card series on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK -- Cam Schlittler fanned 10 in 6 1/3 dominant innings while Ben Rice homered twice and drove in six runs as the New York Yankees pulled away for a 9-0 rout of the Boston Red Sox in Game 1 of an American League wild-card series on Tuesday night. "Ben has excelled very well in the organization," Schlittler said. "He was someone I knew while I was in the minors of how well he was excelling. And, again, it's great to be teammates with him and have that comfortability being from home. And he's been dominant all season. It's very exciting to watch. And I'm glad he can go out there today and get his flowers." The Yankees can close out the best-of-three series on Wednesday when Max Fried pitches. Sonny Gray will try to extend Boston's season to Game 3 on Thursday. Nearly a year after fanning 12 and allowing five hits in eight scoreless innings in Game 3 of last year's wild-card series against Boston, Schlittler (1-0) was equally as sharp in his third career postseason start to help the Yankees get the upper hand. Schlittler allowed just three baserunners, two singles and a walk. His 117 pitches were not only a career high but the most by a Yankee in a postseason game since CC Sabathia threw a 121-pitch complete game in Game 5 of the 2012 AL Division Series against the Baltimore Orioles. "They took some tough at-bats against him, I thought, throughout the night that made it hard for him to get super deep," Yankees manager Aaron Boone said. "But he was terrific. Probably his best curveball of the year to go with obviously, I thought, really good command and in control of his heaters." Schlittler threw 77 pitches for strikes while going up against the team he grew up rooting for in Walpole, Mass. "Cam was obviously awfully good," Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said. "The fastball shapes are well-documented. He's throwing hard. He also had a good curveball today that you know it's there but he used it a little bit more often. He landed it if he wanted to for strikes. He was able to get it beneath for swing and miss. We weren't able to do much with him." Rice, a native of Cohasset, Mass., hit a solo homer for a 2-0 lead in the fifth off left-handed reliever Erik Miller and added an RBI single in the seventh. He capped a five-run eighth by launching a grand slam off Brayan Bello over the right-center-field fence. It was New York's 16th grand slam in a postseason game and the first since Anthony Volpe hit one in Game 3 of the 2024 World Series against the Los Angeles Dodgers. Rice went 4-for-5 and had New York's first four-hit postseason game since Gleyber Torres accomplished the feat in Game 1 of the 2020 wild-card series at Cleveland. "He pummeled pitches all night," Boone said. "They went after him a little bit and he made them pay. I mean, some great left-on-left at-bats, the double to right-center smoke, the homer out the front door in Monument Park. And an exclamation point there at the end. Just a big-time night by a great hitter." Catcher Austin Wells helped Schlittler by winning an ABS challenge on Wilyer Abreu for a called third strike to end the first inning and hit an RBI single with two on in the second against Boston starter Payton Tolle. Rookie George Lombard Jr. had three hits and two runs. Tolle allowed one run on five hits in 4 2/3 innings. The left-hander struck out four, walked one and threw 58 of 83 pitches for strikes. Paul Blackburn (1 2/3 innings) and John Schreiber (one inning) finished the Yankees' three-hitter. --Larry Fleisher, Field Level Media

item.title: Republican Senator Wicker says US security commitments to Taiwan must be upheld
item.description: Republican US Senator and Senate Armed Services Committee Chairman Roger Wicker said Washington's security commitments to Taiwan must be upheld, following a meeting on Tuesday with Alexander Yui, the democratically governed island's representative to the US.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Republican US Senator and Senate Armed Services Committee Chairman Roger Wicker said Washington's security commitments to Taiwan must be upheld, following a meeting on Tuesday with Alexander Yui, the democratically governed island's representative to the US . Four other senators from US President Donald Trump's Republican Party [USN:L1N45F134 TEXT:"called"] on his administration last week to release more than $15 billion in stalled national [USN:L1N45L01U TEXT:"security assistance for Taiwan"]. The United States does not have formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan, but is the island's most important international backer and weapons supplier. Washington is bound by the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act to provide Taiwan, which Beijing claims as its own territory, with the means to defend itself. "As members of Congress, we have a duty to make sure this law is adhered to and that decisions about the defense needs of Taiwan are based on our joint assessment of military necessity," Wicker said in a statement. Wicker also said he discussed with Yui what he called the rise of Chinese aggression against the United States' Indo-Pacific allies. "In response — and in accordance with the Taiwan Relations Act — Congress has authorized and appropriated a surge in resources to provide Taiwan with enhanced training, security assistance, and arms sales. These authorities must be used for the purposes that Congress intended," Wicker added. China has repeatedly called for Taiwan arms sales to end, and in May, following a Beijing trip, Trump said he was keeping a new package worth some $14 billion in abeyance. However, after meeting President Xi Jinping in Washington last week, Trump said only that the Chinese leader understood his position on Taiwan. Wicker urged the US to uphold a precedent when then-President Ronald Reagan said Washington would not consult Beijing on arms sales to Taiwan. Taiwan's government rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims and says only the island's people can decide their future. Taiwan is in continuous talks with Washington about arms sales and had received [USN:L1N45L01U TEXT:"reassurances"] since the summit between Trump and Xi that US policy on Taiwan had not changed, Taiwan Defence Minister Wellington Koo said earlier on Tuesday.
