item.title: 債券はもみ合う展開へ、米指標の発表控え－円は対ドル157円台前半
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 30日の債券相場は米経済指標の発表を控えてもみ合う展開が予想される。外国為替市場で円は対ドルで157円台前半と前日夕と同水準で推移している。

原油価格の高止まりでインフレ懸念がくすぶるなか、米30年債利回りは一時、前日比7ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）余り上昇して5.61%を付け、ドットコム・バブル崩壊後の2002年以来の高水準となった。米10年債利回りは一時5.29%を上回り、07年以来の高水準を付けた。一方、2年債利回りは低下している。

三井住友トラスト・アセットマネジメントの稲留克俊シニアストラテジストは、日本も10月追加利上げという見方が浮上したが、米国の利上げ観測が根拠にあったと指摘。米利上げ観測が後退したことで、日本も金融政策に反応しやすい2年債の金利が下がりやすくなるのではないか、と話した。

超長期債は、国内の財政拡張や日銀のビハインド・ザ・カーブへの懸念を受け、上昇しやすいとみている。一方、8月の米個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数の発表を控え、きょうの相場はもみ合いを予想する。

先物の夜間取引で中心限月12月物は29日の日中取引終値比1銭高の124円36銭で終えた。稲留氏の先物の予想レンジは124円20銭－124円50銭、新発10年債利回りは3.075－3.095%（29日は3.085%で終了）。29日の米10年国債利回りは前日から横ばいの5.23%程度。

30日朝の外国為替市場で円は対ドルで157円台前半と前日夕からやや円高方向で推移。

ドル指数は29日まで2営業日連続で上昇し、2カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

ただ、円は介入警戒感やリスクオフ的な相場から主要10通貨（G10）全体で見ると健闘している、とみずほ銀行国際為替部の長谷川久悟マーケット・エコノミストは話す。

あす公表される日本銀行の金融政策決定会合における主な意見や2日発表の米雇用統計までは「方向感が出にくい」と指摘。今日は1ドル＝157円台前半での推移が中心となるとの見方を示した。

item.title: Enfermeira é acusada de ajudar imigrante a fugir da custódia do ICE nos EUA
item.description: Uma enfermeira de Michigan foi acusada de ajudar um cidadão mexicano a fugir da custódia do Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA (ICE) no hospital onde trabalhava, mostraram documentos judiciais divulgados nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: Uma enfermeira de Michigan foi acusada de ajudar um cidadão mexicano a fugir da custódia do Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA (ICE) no hospital onde trabalhava, mostraram documentos judiciais divulgados nesta terça-feira. Chloe Renae Freeman, 33, de Whitmore Lake, Michigan, foi acusada no final de agosto de ajudar “deliberadamente” um imigrante não identificado, sujeito a deportação dos Estados Unidos, a fugir da custódia federal no Trinity Health Ann Arbor Hospital, afirmou o agente especial do FBI Michael Wagner em uma denúncia criminal. O cidadão mexicano não identificado havia se ferido ao tentar fugir dos agentes do ICE em 28 de maio, segundo a denúncia. Ele foi levado ao hospital, onde Freeman trabalhava, para uma avaliação médica e, posteriormente, passou por uma tomografia computadorizada, disse Wagner. Após a conclusão do exame, Freeman retirou o imigrante da sala de exames, de acordo com a denúncia. Imagens das câmeras de segurança mostraram o homem saindo do hospital pelas portas da área de ambulâncias menos de três minutos depois que Freeman o retirou de lá, segundo a denúncia. Ele não foi localizado desde então, de acordo com a denúncia. Wagner disse que Freeman admitiu, durante uma entrevista em 18 de junho, que permitiu que o indivíduo saísse do hospital. Embora soubesse que ele era um detido do ICE, ela disse que não acreditava que ele estivesse sob custódia naquele momento, pois os agentes não estavam fisicamente com ele na sala de tomografia computadorizada. “FREEMAN disse aos entrevistadores que não concordava com o ICE separar pessoas de suas famílias e que sabia que ‘iria libertá-lo’”, escreveu Wagner na denúncia. Ele acrescentou que a enfermeira disse acreditar que o homem poderia ter morrido devido aos ferimentos. A Trinity Health informou que Freeman não trabalha mais no hospital. O Departamento de Segurança Interna dos EUA e um advogado de Freeman não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário. Freeman deveria comparecer ao tribunal federal em Detroit nesta terça-feira, de acordo com o Detroit News. Seu advogado, Matthew Borgula, disse ao jornal que ela planeja se declarar inocente.

item.title: Jerry Jones: ‘No explanation’ for Cowboys’ late clock management
item.description: Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said there was "no explanation" that could justify his team's late clock-management mistakes in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Brazil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said there was "no explanation" that could justify his team's late clock-management mistakes in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Brazil. Dallas appeared headed for overtime after Brandon Aubrey kicked a tying 23-yard field goal with seven seconds remaining. Instead, Baltimore quarterback Lamar Jackson completed a 27-yard pass to Zay Flowers, allowing the Ravens to call timeout with one second left before Tyler Loop drilled a game-winning 56-yard field goal. The Cowboys had opportunities to leave the Ravens with considerably less time. Dallas reached first-and-goal at the Baltimore 2-yard line with 23 seconds remaining. After an incompletion and a false-start penalty, Dak Prescott scrambled to the 5 before coach Brian Schottenheimer used the Cowboys' final timeout with 14 seconds left. Prescott then quickly threw the ball away on third down, taking only four seconds off the clock. "There is no explanation you're satisfied with. None," Jones said Tuesday on 105.3 The Fan in Dallas. "Let's be sure that we all understand that. They (the coaches) don't have one that they're satisfied with." Schottenheimer acknowledged after the game that he instructed Prescott to either target George Pickens or throw the ball away. "That's on me," Schottenheimer said. "I overcoached him." Jones said the Cowboys recognize the issue but must turn the breakdown into something useful. "We made mistakes during that time," Jones said. "There's no question about it, so there is no explanation, but there's an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again, which is what you should be doing. You can't get that back." Despite the frustrating finish, Jones remains optimistic about the Cowboys, who fell to 1-2 and visit the Houston Texans on Sunday. "We will be better from this experience and what happened to us at the end of the game," Jones said. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米国債先物に売り持ち集中、弱い経済指標なら利回り急低下も
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国債利回りが約20年ぶりの高水準からさらに上昇すると見込む取引が拡大している。景気の顕著な減速を示す兆候が出れば、ポジションが急速に巻き戻されるリスクが高まっている。

こうした状況を受け、債券トレーダーは今週発表される一連の主要指標に注目している。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が重視するインフレ指標が30日に発表されるほか、10月2日には9月の雇用統計の公表を控える。雇用者数の伸びは鈍化すると予想されている。

米シカゴ商品取引所（CME）のデータによると、過去2週間ほどで、5年債と10年債の先物の建玉はともに急増した。5年債先物では過去12営業日のうち11日で、10年債先物では過去14営業日のうち13日で、それぞれ建玉が増加した。

今週、イールドカーブ全体で利回りが数年ぶりの高水準に上昇したことは、先物市場での新たな取引が売り手主導であることを示している。米商品先物取引委員会（CFTC）のデータによると、22日までの1週間に資産運用会社は10年債先物のショートポジションを10万枚超積み増した。週間の増加幅としては2023年以来最大級となった。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ（BofA）のメーガン・スワイバー氏らストラテジストはリポートで、「先物のポジションは引き続き利回り上昇方向に偏っており、（短期から中期の年限では）ショートがなお含み益を抱えている」と指摘。「資産運用会社は引き続き米国債のショートを積み増しており、特に中長期の年限で顕著だ」とし、商品投資顧問業者（CTA）の動向も「米国債の売り持ちに大きく傾いた」状態が続いていることを示唆しているとした。

29日には数カ月にわたる米国債相場低迷が一段と進み、30年債利回りは2002年以来の高水準に上昇した。大量の社債発行が市場の重しとなった。インフレ圧力を高めているエネルギー価格の高止まりも、ショートポジション拡大の大きな要因となっている。

item.title: 日本株は反発へ、米半導体株高が追い風－原油の上昇一服も支え
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 30日の日本株は反発する見込み。収益期待から米半導体株が上昇したことで、AI・半導体関連が買われやすい。

供給懸念の緩和を受けて原油先物価格の上昇が一服したことも支えとなる。半面、国内外で金利の先高観が強いことは引き続き相場の重しになる。

個別ではソフトバンクグループ株が注目される。同社が出資する米OpenAIは、新規株式公開（IPO）計画を先送りしたことを受けて、新たな資金調達ラウンドで少なくとも300億ドル（約4兆7200億円）の調達を目指している。

item.title: Comando, el más pequeño integrante perruno de la Guardia Nacional Mexicana
item.description: Equipado con gafas protectoras miniatura, un chaleco táctico a la medida, casco y hasta una pequeña cámara sobre su cabeza, "Comando", un perro chihuahua que se ha convertido en el integrante más insólito y pequeño de la Guardia Nacional de México, está siendo entrenado no solo para tratar de acercar los uniformados a la ciudadanía sino también para que se especialice en labores de búsqueda y rescate.
item.dc:creator: Lizbeth Diaz
item.content:encoded: Equipado con gafas protectoras miniatura, un chaleco táctico a la medida, casco y hasta una pequeña cámara sobre su cabeza, "Comando", un perro chihuahua que se ha convertido en el integrante más insólito y pequeño de la Guardia Nacional de México, está siendo entrenado no solo para tratar de acercar los uniformados a la ciudadanía sino también para que se especialice en labores de búsqueda y rescate. Muy diferente de los canes de gran porte que habitualmente integran las fuerzas de seguridad para tareas de salvamento o detección de narcóticos y explosivos, el nuevo elemento canino de la Guardia Nacional, de 13 meses, subía escaleras y saltaba obstáculos en un entrenamiento el miércoles en una instalación militar de Ciudad de México. Otro compañero de cuatro patas, Roko, más grande y capacitado, parecía vigilar cómo lo hacía. Comando Chihuahua, como también le llaman al perro de siete kilos y 21 centímetros de altura, viene a romper dos paradigmas, dijo Débora Hernández, teniente de la Guardia Nacional poco antes del entrenamiento al que asistió Reuters. Uno, que se sepa que no solo los perros grandes pueden estar dentro de la Guardia Nacional y dos, que existe un "ejército, unas fuerzas armadas, con mayor contacto con la ciudadanía, que vean que debajo del uniforme somos seres humanos". El canino, que fue adoptado hace unos seis meses en el norteño estado fronterizo de Chihuahua, vivía previamente con una pareja de adultos mayores que ya no podía cuidarlo debido a limitaciones físicas. Tras ser rescatado por los agentes, su historia dio un giro de 180 grados al ser integrado "formalmente" a las filas institucionales. Comando suele acompañar a las tropas en eventos cívicos, ferias escolares y actividades de proximidad social, diseñadas para fomentar la denuncia delictiva y reconstruir el tejido social, señaló Hernández. El can ya ha aprendido órdenes básicas de obediencia, cuenta con aditamentos diseñados exclusivamente para su tamaño y recientemente participó en el desfile conmemorativo de la Independencia de México en la capital. La Guardia Nacional mexicana cuenta con una fuerza canina de unos 350 ejemplares, dominada principalmente por razas de trabajo como el pastor belga malinois, el pastor alemán, el pastor holandés, el labrador y el xoloitzcuintle, una emblemática raza mexicana. Comando, que ya tiene su propia figura animada y memes en redes sociales, rompe con ese estándar. Los chihuahuas son conocidos por ser perros de compañía alertas y enérgicos, pero su tamaño y fisionomía no son aptos para labores de contención, rastreo o patrullaje de alto impacto. Su presencia, según Hernández, busca suavizar la imagen del cuerpo de seguridad, creado en 2019 bajo un mando civil pero transferido en 2024 al control del Ejército, una medida que generó debate en el país por la creciente militarización de la seguridad pública.

item.title: Maple Leafs confirm 6-year extension for Kirill Marchenko after trade
item.description: One day after acquiring Kirill Marchenko in a blockbuster trade on the eve of the regular season, the Toronto Maple Leafs confirmed Tuesday that the forward signed a six-year contract extension.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: One day after acquiring Kirill Marchenko in a blockbuster trade on the eve of the regular season, the Toronto Maple Leafs confirmed Tuesday that the forward signed a six-year contract extension. The team did not disclose the financial terms, but Marchenko's agent previously announced that the deal was worth $75 million, for an average annual value of $12.5 million. The Leafs acquired Marchenko, fellow forward Miles Wood and goaltender Elvis Merzlikins from the Columbus Blue Jackets on Monday, sending forwards Matthew Knies and Steven Lorentz, defenseman Emil Andrae and a second-round pick in the 2027 draft to the Jackets. Marchenko, 26, was entering the final season of a three-year contract with a $3.85 million cap hit. When it begins next season, Marchenko's new deal will carry Toronto's second-highest average annual value, behind only captain Auston Matthews' $13.25 million. The Russian winger gives the Maple Leafs another proven scorer after an offseason filled with roster turnover. He'll join the likes of Matthews, William Nylander, John Tavares and No. 1 overall draft pick Gavin McKenna in Toronto's forward group. Marchenko recorded 27 goals and 40 assists in 76 games last season. He has scored at least 20 goals in each of his four NHL campaigns, highlighted by career highs of 31 goals and 74 points in 2024-25. The Maple Leafs host the rival Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday to kick off the 2026-27 season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Falha em motor da Starship, da SpaceX, pode afetar objetivos da missão lunar da Nasa
item.description: A falha no motor da Starship que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: A falha no motor da Starship que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua. Projetada em parte para transportar grandes cargas úteis para o espaço, a Starship é uma das duas naves que disputam o título de primeira a ser utilizada pela Nasa já em 2028 para levar seres humanos à Lua e trazê-los de volta em segurança, feito alcançado pela última vez em 1972, no final da era Apollo. Embora a Starship tenha alcançado diversos objetivos-chave em seu último lançamento de teste, realizado na segunda-feira no Texas, a missão foi encurtada em várias horas após uma falha em seu sistema de propulsão. Apesar da desativação inesperada de um de seus três motores principais Raptor após a separação da Starship do foguete impulsionador do estágio inferior, os controladores de voo prosseguiram com o envio da espaçonave à órbita para seu primeiro lançamento comercial de satélite. Determinar o que causou a falha no motor continua sendo fundamental para os resultados financeiros da SpaceX. Mas os riscos são potencialmente maiores para a Nasa, já que um veículo de pouso lunar da Starship dependeria do mesmo sistema de motores para transportar astronautas pelo espaço para a superfície lunar e depois de volta à Terra. O tamanho do estrago que a falha no motor representará para o andamento do desenvolvimento da Starship vai depender do tipo de problema -- se ela tiver sido “uma falha pontual de uma única peça” ou se indicar um problema de projeto mais amplo que exija atualizações “em toda a frota”, disse Dean Sladen, engenheiro aeroespacial da Accu Components. “Qualquer correção no motor que atrase os próximos voos, incluindo a tentativa prevista de capturar a nave com os braços da torre de lançamento (após a reentrada), prejudica esse cronograma”, avaliou. A SpaceX não respondeu imediatamente a pedidos de comentário da Reuters. Um porta-voz da Nasa não respondeu às perguntas da Reuters sobre o problema no motor ou sobre o programa Artemis, mas indicou uma postagem no X do chefe da agência espacial dos EUA, Jared Isaacman, na qual ele afirma que a Starship “teve uma ótima missão” e “alcançou um marco importante”. Um atraso maior representaria não apenas um revés ainda maior para as ambições comerciais da SpaceX de expandir rapidamente sua rede de satélites de banda larga Starlink, mas também para seu papel fundamental no programa lunar Artemis da Nasa. “A verdadeira pressão é a Lua. A Nasa precisa da Starship para a Artemis 3”, uma missão de teste em órbita terrestre prevista para o próximo verão, que funcionará como um voo de ensaio para o primeiro pouso lunar tripulado do programa, disse Sladen. Problemas com o motor Raptor e o sistema de propulsão já contribuíram para contratempos anteriores da Starship, incluindo um motor que não acendeu conforme planejado durante o 12º voo, em maio. Os motores movidos a metano estão entre os componentes mais complexos e caros do foguete. Durante alguns voos anteriores, a SpaceX cancelou os planos de realizar um teste de ignição do motor Raptor no espaço. Mas todos os motores foram acionados com sucesso durante a ascensão no 13º voo da Starship, em julho. Empresa recém-aberta ao mercado fundada por Elon Musk perto de Los Angeles em 2002, SpaceX (SPCX.O) está competindo com a Blue Origin, empresa rival de foguetes do também empresário Jeff Bezos, para inaugurar uma era de exploração lunar no âmbito do programa Artemis da Nasa. Embora a SpaceX tenha sido originalmente contratada para fornecer o primeiro módulo de pouso lunar tripulado para o Artemis, Isaacman afirmou em abril que a Nasa optaria pelo módulo que estivesse pronto para voar primeiro. A Nasa considerou essa concorrência adicional saudável para o progresso, tendo em vista os crescentes atrasos no programa de voos de teste da Starship. A Nasa tem como meta oficial levar astronautas de volta à superfície da Lua até 2028, objetivo amplamente considerado excessivamente ambicioso, para chegar lá antes da China, que planeja um pouso lunar tripulado até 2030. Um módulo de pouso lunar em funcionamento também será necessário para a missão precursora Artemis 3, já no verão de 2027, para testar manobras de rendezvous e acoplamento na órbita terrestre baixa. A SpaceX está desenvolvendo um Sistema de Pouso Tripulado (Human Landing System) baseado em sua nave Starship, um imponente veículo de aço inoxidável muito maior do que qualquer módulo de pouso lunar já construído. A Blue Origin está construindo seu próprio módulo de pouso, o Blue Moon, baseando-se em uma filosofia de projeto mais tradicional. Se estiverem prontos, os dois módulos de pouso provavelmente participarão da missão Artemis 3, demonstrando manobras orbitais com seus motores espaciais. Isaacman divulgou publicamente a estratégia dos módulos de pouso concorrentes dias após a conclusão da missão Artemis 2 da Nasa, que levou astronautas ao redor da Lua e de volta à Terra no primeiro lançamento tripulado do foguete Space Launch System da Nasa, construído pela Boeing (BA.N) e pela Northrop Grumman (NOC.N) , e da cápsula Orion, fabricada pela Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) .

item.title: スマートリングのオーラが米ＩＰＯ延期、市場不安定化で上場見送り相次ぐ
item.description:
Manya Saini
[２９日 ロイター] - スマートリング・メーカーのオーラは２９日、米国で予定していた新規株式...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スマートリングのオーラが米ＩＰＯ延期、市場不安定化で上場見送り相次ぐ 7:31 配信

写真はオーラのロゴイメージ。8月27日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Manya Saini

[２９日 ロイター] - スマートリング・メーカーのオーラは２９日、米国で予定していた新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を延期した。市場環境が不安定化して投資家の新規上場銘柄に対する需要が弱まっており、注目企業が上場計画を見送る動きが相次いでいる。今月に入ってからは、原子力サービス会社ホルテックが予定していた米ＩＰＯを停止したほか、バンブー・インシュアランスも上場を先送りした。

米ＩＰＯ市場は年初に好調な滑り出しを見せたものの、人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラへの巨額投資が持続可能かどうかを巡る疑念や、高水準にある企業価値を投資家が改めて精査する動きが影を落とし始めた。債券利回りの上昇に加え、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げへの懸念、地政学的な混乱も投資家心理の重荷だ。

マージャーマーケットの株式資本市場グローバル責任者サミュエル・カー氏は「数週間前に想定していたＩＰＯ市場とは全く異なる状況にあることが明確になった。非常に優れた収益性を持つ企業であっても、これまで以上に厳しく精査されるだろう」と述べた。

オーラと一部の既存株主は、ＩＰＯで５０００万株を１株４０－４４ドルの仮条件で売り出す予定だった。仮条件レンジの上限で価格が決まった場合、調達額は２２億ドル、完全希薄化後の企業価値は１５６億２０００万ドルとなる見通しだった。

当初は２９日中に公開価格を決定し、３０日にナスダック市場で取引を開始する運びになっていた。フィンランドで１０年以上前に創業したオーラは、昨年の資金調達で約１１０億ドルの企業価値と評価されていた。

ＩＰＯＸリサーチのアソシエート、ルーカス・ミュールバウアー氏は「金利上昇によって、投資家が特に成長企業の評価に対して明らかに選別姿勢を強めている」と指摘。もっともＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックが大型ＩＰＯに向けた計画を進めていることから「ＩＰＯの窓口が閉じたとは言えない」と付け加えた。

オーラの上場は、夏場の閑散期を終えた秋の米ＩＰＯ市場で初の大型案件になる予定で、高成長企業に対する投資家需要を測る試金石として注目されていた。トム・ヘイル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「従業員と投資家にとって素晴らしいＩＰＯを実現することを目指しており、われわれには時期を選べる余裕がある。その間も目の前にある成長機会を着実に実行していく」と強調した。同社によると、事業は黒字化しており、２０２６年度の売上高は前年度比９０％増を見込んでいる。

ミュールバウアー氏はオーラのＩＰＯについて「募集額に対して約４倍の需要があったと報じられている。十分な需要ではあるが、知名度の高い消費者向けブランドとしては必ずしも圧倒的とは言えない」と分析した。

オーラは心臓の健康状態や身体活動、睡眠などを計測するスマートリングの普及をけん引してきた。同社によると、主力製品「オーラリング５」の発売後の反応は「極めて好調」で、プラットフォームの有料会員数は５７０万人に達した。

スマートリングは、従来型のフィットネストラッカーとスマートウオッチの中間に位置する製品として市場を開拓している。小型で画面を持たず、長時間着用しやすいほか、一般的にバッテリーの持続時間が長く、個人の健康状態に応じた情報を提供できることが特徴だ。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：ビットコインＥＴＦ初承認、実用化拡大はなお遠い アングル：来年のＩＰＯ回復に期待、米利下げ観測が追い風 アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 焦点：ＳＨＥＩＮの香港上場、ＥＳＧ問題がなお影　投資家の懸念根強く 最終更新: 9/30(水) 7:31 ロイター

item.title: Goldman private credit fund defies industry elevated withdrawal trend yet again
item.description: Goldman Sachs' private credit fund said on Tuesday that investor requests to pull money further slowed down in the third-quarter tender offer, with redemption pressure easing across the broader industry.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs' (GS.N) private credit fund said on Tuesday that investor requests to pull money further slowed down in the third-quarter tender offer, with redemption pressure easing across the broader industry. The $18.2 billion GS Credit fund [USN:L4N43314C TEXT:"once again outperformed"] most other private credit players, with investors seeking to pull just 2% of shares in the latest tender offer, compared with 3.2% in the prior quarter. Its repurchase requests have remained below the customary 5% limit since inception. Meanwhile, withdrawal [USN:L4N45H0L4 TEXT:"requests"] at the biggest non-traded private credit funds have ranged from 10% to over 16% of shares in the third-quarter tender offers unveiled so far. Data from Blue Owl (OWL.N) funds is expected in the coming days. Rival funds have grappled with elevated redemption requests throughout 2026, driven by concerns about lending standards and whether software companies that have borrowed heavily from direct lenders will weather AI disruption. That said, redemption pressure at major funds is showing signs of easing as asset managers clear backlogs of withdrawal requests and investor sentiment rebounds from recent turbulence. A huge chunk of GS Credit investors come from Goldman's private wealth channels, who have been long-term investors in the private credit space and can tolerate illiquidity, [USN:L4N40P0HZ TEXT:"Reuters has reported."] "The concerns around software-related credit quality that dominated headlines earlier in 2026 have begun to moderate. While Q1's "SaaSpocalypse" narrative and Q2's enterprise software spend uncertainty drove aggressive spread widening, the Q3 landscape has shifted meaningfully," GS Credit said. On the subscriptions side, GS Credit said it generated roughly $400 million of gross inflows during the quarter. Its Class I shares have delivered a roughly 9.4% total return since inception through August 31, 2026.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico ask judge to extend block on White House ban
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico asked a federal judge on Monday to issue a court order preserving their White House access while they fight US President Donald Trump’s move to ban them over coverage he dislikes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CNN, MS NOW and Politico asked a federal judge on Monday to issue a court order [USN:FWN45F0Z6 TEXT:"preserving their White House access"] while they fight US President Donald Trump’s move to [USN:L8N45A1OV TEXT:"ban them"] over coverage he dislikes. The news outlets asked a judge overseeing their case in Washington, D.C., federal court to grant a preliminary injunction blocking Trump’s bans until there is a final ruling in the case. US District Judge Timothy Kelly previously issued a 14-day temporary restraining order blocking the bans, finding they likely violated the news outlets’ rights to fair legal treatment. Despite the order, CNN on Friday said it was [USN:L1N45H0F8 TEXT:"barred"] from traveling with Trump on Air Force One for a weekend trip to Tennessee. The plaintiffs' filing referenced the episode to argue that the “White House has persisted in unpredictably and inconsistently” implementing the ban. The judge’s order preserving the outlets' White House access expires on October 8. The outlets had said in their September 21 lawsuit that Trump’s bans were unlawful viewpoint discrimination under the First Amendment of the Constitution, which guarantees free speech and free press rights. The Justice Department said Trump lawfully banned the outlets after determining their coverage threatened national security by revealing classified information. Trump said in a September 18 social media post that he was [USN:L8N45A1OV TEXT:"banning the outlets"] accusing them of “reporting FAKE NEWS” and saying they "shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES.” Trump has frequently clashed with the media in his second term and has personally sued outlets including the New York Times (NYT.N) , Wall Street Journal and BBC for alleged defamation. The Trump administration has until Friday to respond to the outlets' Monday filing, CNN said in a statement.

item.title: Imagen de manifestación en Sinaloa fue alterada para simular mayor asistencia
item.description: Una imagen aérea de una marcha en contra de la violencia en Culiacán, Sinaloa, compartida en línea el 13 de septiembre, fue alterada digitalmente para incluir a más asistentes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Una imagen aérea de una marcha en contra de la violencia en Culiacán, Sinaloa, compartida en línea el 13 de septiembre, fue alterada digitalmente para incluir a más asistentes. Estos son los detalles clave: Publicaciones en redes sociales comparten una imagen de una calle llena de manifestantes durante la marcha “Sinaloa, ponte de pie”. Imágenes tomadas por Reuters en la protesta muestran a grupos de personas con pancartas en contra de la violencia en Culiacán. El medio Debate publicó el 13 de septiembre la imagen sin editar junto a otras de la manifestación. En la fotografía sin editar se ve que la afluencia de asistentes es menor y que algunos letreros de comercios aledaños son legibles, a comparación de la imagen publicada en redes sociales. Arturo Félix, autor de la fotografía, dijo a Reuters el 24 de septiembre que vio una afluencia menor de asistentes que la mostrada en la versión en redes sociales y que creía que dicha imagen probablemente fue realizada basándose en su foto original. También compartió otras fotografías aéreas tomadas en momentos cercanos a esa imagen que muestran una asistencia menor. Un análisis realizado con la herramienta de detección de OpenAI determinó que la imagen probablemente fue editada o creada usando los modelos de inteligencia artificial de la compañía. La herramienta de verificación detecta marcas de agua invisibles incrustadas en los contenidos generados. Reuters geolocalizó la imagen en el cruce de las calles prolongación Álvaro Obregón y Constitución. Veredicto: Alterada. La imagen fue modificada para incluir a más manifestantes sobre la calle durante una marcha en Culiacán. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: アンソロピック、クラウド大手への事業依存鮮明 売上高や計算資源に集中リスク
item.description:
Echo Wang Krystal Hu
[２９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの新規株式...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック、クラウド大手への事業依存鮮明　売上高や計算資源に集中リスク 7:19 配信

写真はアンソロピックのロゴ。9月17日、米カリフォルニア州サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Echo Wang　Krystal Hu

[２９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けた目論見書で、売上高や計算資源確保などに関して一部の大口顧客やクラウド大手に大きく依存し、リスクを生み出している実態が明らかになった。

ロイターが確認した非公開のＩＰＯ申請書類によると、２０２５年は売上高の４７％が、アマゾン・ドット・コムと米アルファベット傘下グーグルのクラウドサービス経由だった。アマゾンとアルファベットはアンソロピックのＡＩサービスの販売網を広げ、顧客から代金を回収する一方、同社の大株主で、計算資源の主要な供給元でもある。ただＡＩ分野では直接の競合相手にもなっている。

アマゾンはコメントを拒否。アンソロピックとアルファベットはコメント要請に回答していない。

アンソロピックは数年前にはほぼ存在しなかった企業だが、大規模言語モデル（ＬＬＭ）の主要開発企業として急成長してきた。ＩＰＯでは約２兆ドルの企業価値を目指し、成長加速に向け今後数年間で数千億ドルを投じる計画だ。

ロイターが２８日に報じたところでは、２５年の売上高は前年比１２倍の約４６億ドルに急増。営業損失は２倍以上に拡大し、８０億ドルを超えた。売上高の約３分の２を米国が占めた。

売上高のうち約３８億ドルは、アンソロピックの生成ＡＩ「クロード」の利用量に応じて料金を支払う従量課金型の顧客から得た。サブスクリプション収入は７億８９００万ドル。同社は今後も「相当大部分」を従量課金型の収入が占めるとの見通しを示している。

一方２５年にクラウド事業者のマーケットプレイス経由で得た売上高は約２１億６０００万ドルで、年間売上高の４７％を占めた。ロイターの分析に基づくと、アンソロピックは販売手数料として両プラットフォームに約３億５１００万ドルを支払った。クラウド事業者が販売額１ドル当たり約０．１６ドルを受け取った計算になる。同社はこうした販売提携先への手数料を財務諸表の「販売・マーケティング・パートナーシップ」費用に計上している。

このような手数料は、アンソロピックと大手テクノロジー企業の間で複雑化する資金関係の一端をうかがわせる。アマゾンとグーグルはアンソロピックに数百億ドルを投資する一方、アンソロピックは両社などから巨額のコンピューティング能力を調達する契約を結んでいる構図だ。

２５年末時点で、アンソロピックが抱える解約不能のホスティング・コンピューティング契約は５４６億ドルに上った。２６年初めには長期契約の総額が４１７０億ドルを超え、専用の計算能力は３．５ギガワットに達した。

アンソロピックは目論見書で、クラウド大手との関係を強みとして説明。アマゾン、グーグル、マイクロソフトのクラウド基盤を通じてクロードを提供することで、各社の広範な販売網にアクセスし、既存顧客にサービスを届けられるとしている。「単独の企業では直接再現することが困難と考えられる規模」で市場への浸透を加速できると強調した。

しかし限られた提携先や供給業者への依存は「利益相反を生じさせ、計算資源へのアクセスに悪影響を及ぼす恐れのある複雑な力学を生み出す」とリスクも認めた。

目論見書によると、クラウド事業者はアンソロピックの価格設定や契約条件も把握可能なため、各社による計算資源の配分や、アンソロピック製品をどの程度積極的に販売するかという判断に影響する可能性がある。クラウド事業者自体もアンソロピックの顧客だという。

アマゾンとグーグルへの依存度はアンソロピックの売上高の急成長とともに大きくなり、両社を経由した売上高の比率は２３年の１１％から２４年に３２％に上昇、２５年には半分近くまで高まった。

代金回収でも第三者への依存が増大。２５年末時点の売掛金９億０９００万ドルのうち、６０％をクラウド事業者が顧客から回収し、２４年の４２％から上昇した。アンソロピックは顧客と直接契約しているものの、代金回収を巡る紛争や遅延が発生すれば、キャッシュフローに悪影響を及ぼす可能性があると警告した。

顧客自体の集中度も高い。社名を明らかにしていない２社が、それぞれ２５年の売上高の１２％を占めた。アンソロピックは大口顧客の多くとは長期契約を結んでおらず、顧客が支出を減らしたり停止したりする可能性があるとしている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 最終更新: 9/30(水) 7:19 ロイター

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（29日）ドル上昇、2年債利回り低下 株小幅続落
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、対ユーロと対スイスフランで１年４カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（29日）ドル上昇、2年債利回り低下　株小幅続落 7:07 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、対ユーロと対スイスフランで１年４カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げに動くか見極めようと一連の米経済指標が注目される中、米国債利回りが数年ぶりの高水準近辺で推移していることがドルの下支えになっている。

ドル／円はほぼ横ばいの１５７．３０円近辺。片山さつき財務相は２９日の閣議後会見で、今後の為替政策について「引き続き日米当局の間で緊密なコミュニケーションを維持し、秩序ある為替市場の維持に取り組む」と発言。市場では日米の協調介入の可能性を探る動きが出ている。

ユーロに対しては世界的なエネルギーショックのほか、欧州の政治リスクの高まりが重石になっており、ユーロ／ドルは一時１．１３１２ドルと、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。終盤の取引では０．２６％安の１．１３４１ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ ２年債利回りが低下した。ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が、次回の利上げ時期を判断するために連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）には経済指標を見極める時間的余裕があるとの認識を示したことを受け、市場ではＦＲＢによる来月の利上げ観測が後退した。

この日発表の経済指標では、米コンファレンス・ボード（ＣＢ）が発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数は８１．９と、前月から６．７ポイント低下し、２０１４年以来約１２年半ぶりの低水準となった。

労働市場関連では、８月の雇用動態調査（ＪＯＬＴＳ）による求人件数は前月から２５万６０００件減少し、７０７万９０００件となった。週内には９月の米雇用統計の発表も控える。

１０年債利回りは１．３２ｂｐ上昇の５．２５５％。取引時間中に２００７年６月中旬以来の高水準となる５．２９３２％を付けた。

３０年債利回りは３ｂｐ上昇の５．５９２％。午前の取引で０２年６月以来の高水準に達した。

一方、２年債利回りは３．５１ｂｐ低下の４．８８９％。取引序盤で２４年５月以来の高水準となる４．９５９６％を付けた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 小幅続落で取引を終えた。米国債利回りが上昇を続けたほか、インフレ指標と雇用統計の発表を控え、投資家は金利の道筋を巡り米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者の発言を見極めたいとの姿勢を見せた。

中東からの輸出回復の兆しを受けた原油価格の下落や、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁の発言を背景に、長期債利回りはこの日の高水準から低下し、短期債利回りは前日を下回った。これを受け、株価も下げ幅を縮小した。ウィリアムズ総裁は、次回の利上げ時期を判断するためにＦＲＢには経済指標を見極める時間的余裕があるとの認識を示した。nL6N45L17A

今週は重要経済指標の発表が相次ぐ。３０日に商務省が発表する個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策の方向性を左右する可能性がある。１０月２日の雇用統計など、労働市場関連の指標も週を通じて発表される。

メタ・プラットフォームズは、ライバルのオープンＡＩがメタの「ミューズ」の競合とみられる常時稼働型のエージェント「ドッツ」を発表したものの、約３％上昇した。

中古車販売のカーマックスは４．７％高。第２・四半期決算が増収増益となったことを好感した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

item.title: North Korea calls DMZ mine blast a 'farce' as UN Command says armistice breach occurred
item.description: North Korea on Wednesday dismissed as a "farce" a South Korean investigation that found Pyongyang responsible for a mine blast in the Demilitarized Zone that wounded South Korean soldiers, as the UN Command said the incident constituted a violation of the Korean War armistice.
item.dc:creator: Jack Kim, Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: North Korea on Wednesday dismissed as a "farce" a South Korean investigation that found Pyongyang responsible for a mine blast in the Demilitarized Zone that wounded South Korean soldiers, as the UN Command said the incident constituted a violation of the Korean War armistice. Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un, accused Seoul of trying to fabricate evidence after blaming Pyongyang for last week's explosion. "It is too low and dirty as befitting the tribes of South Korea," Kim said in a statement carried by state media KCNA. "Such a farce is by no means new." South Korea's [USN:L1N45L07A TEXT:"defence minister"] said on Tuesday that North Korean mines caused the blast and that it would take "corresponding" action. Kang Shin-chul also said North Korea likely planted mines as part of fortifying the border. South Korea and the UN Command, which oversees the Korean War armistice, have been investigating the September 21 blast that wounded three South Korean personnel, including two seriously, during a reconnaissance mission inside the 4-km (2.49-mile) wide DMZ. 'ARMISTICE AGREEMENT VIOLATION' The UN Command in a statement on Wednesday said that it had conducted a joint on-site investigation with the South Korean military. During the investigation, the team identified another active North Korean anti-personnel mine on the South Korean side of the Military Demarcation Line bisecting the DMZ, it said. "Based on the findings of the investigation, UNC determined that an Armistice Agreement violation occurred," the command said, adding that it was addressing the violation through established armistice mechanisms. Kim called it "the height of impudence" that South Korea was attempting to fabricate "material evidence" and denied North Korean troops had crossed the Military Demarcation Line while carrying out border construction work. She said Pyongyang had made no secret of building border barriers and described the work as "a thorough exercise of sovereignty unrelated with any military purpose." Kim also accused South Korea of provoking tensions by firing warning shots on the pretext that North Korean troops had crossed the border. Seoul has previously said there were signs North Korean soldiers briefly crossed the line while carrying out fortification work. "If a single bullet hits our land, they must be prepared for a lot," Kim said, warning that North Korean border units would respond immediately if South Korean forces opened live fire on its troops. The dispute comes as North Korea presses ahead with large-scale border fortification work, including barriers, roads and mine-laying, after redefining South Korea as a separate hostile state rather than a partner for eventual reunification. COMPLICATES SEOUL'S PUSH FOR DIALOGUE South Korea's military demanded North Korea apologise and halt border fortification work. "All responsibility for any future situation lies entirely with North Korea," Kang Hyunwoo, a Joint Chiefs of Staff official, said in a statement. Kim Min-seok, leader of South Korea's ruling Democratic Party, also urged Pyongyang to apologise. The mine incident could further complicate South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's efforts to reopen dialogue with the North and reduce military tensions on the peninsula. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies, said Kim's remarks also appeared designed to create a justification for future retaliation against South Korean warning shots or broadcasts near the border. "North Korea is accumulating a narrative that any future clash is not the result of its own actions but a response to South Korean provocations," Lim said.

item.title: Trump releases AI accord with tech executives
item.description: President Donald Trump released a document on Tuesday that his administration cast as an accord on artificial intelligence and which he said earlier was signed by him and tech executives that he met in Washington.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump released a document on Tuesday that his administration cast as an accord on artificial intelligence and which he said earlier was signed by him and tech executives that he [USN:L6N45L0Q5 TEXT:"met in Washington"]. Trump released the one-page document on his Truth Social platform - which he had earlier described as "morally binding" - and that urged four layers of controls in companies: It asked companies to partner with an external auditor or evaluator to carry out independent assessments of whether a company's AI control and monitoring systems were operating as intended. It urged companies to designate an independent committee of the board of directors to oversee and receive reports from internal and external auditors and from teams operating AI controls. It asked for internal controls to monitor capabilities and alignment of AI models during training and deployment around areas like cybersecurity, biosecurity and chemical threats to ensure that models "do not hack or access technical systems in unintended ways." The accord asked companies to have an internal team to ensure "all of the controls, monitoring and detection are operating as intended." MORE DETAILS AND QUOTES: The document was signed by Trump and the bosses of Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, social media platform X and NVIDIA. "Over time, it may make sense to codify these steps into laws or regulations. Regardless of whether this is required of companies, we believe that implementing these controls and audits is critical to ensuring a safe future for everyone, and each of our companies are committed to doing this," the White House accord said. "The participating companies will meet regularly to establish standards and best practices to improve the safety of their systems," it added.

item.title: Boeing wins US Navy's next-generation fighter contract, Pentagon says
item.description: Boeing has been selected to build the US Navy's next-generation stealth fighter, the Pentagon said on Tuesday, marking the company's second consecutive major win on fighter jets and capping months of delay over a program central to US strategy for countering China in the Pacific.
item.dc:creator: Mike Stone, Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) has been selected to build the US Navy's next-generation stealth fighter, the Pentagon said on Tuesday, marking the company's second consecutive major win on fighter jets and capping months of delay over a program central to US strategy for countering China in the Pacific. Boeing beat out rival Northrop Grumman Corp (NOC.N) for the development contract, worth $20 billion, to produce test aircraft. The program could grow to hundreds of billions over its lifetime as production ramps up and, potentially, as international customers place orders. Boeing was also selected in March last year to build the Air Force's new stealthy F-47 fighter, giving it two marquee sixth-generation jet contracts in consecutive years. Boeing was viewed as a strong contender throughout the competition because of its long history building carrier-based fighters for the Navy, including the F/A-18E/F Super Hornet that the new fighter is designed to replace. That pedigree helped offset questions raised by defense officials about whether Boeing could field enough engineers and suppliers to execute both the F-47 and Navy fighter simultaneously — concerns that appear to have been resolved in the company's favor. Boeing shares were up 2.25% in extended trading on Tuesday, while Northrop shares were down 3.5%. ST. LOUIS PRODUCTION BOOST The contract is a significant boost for Boeing's fighter production operations in St. Louis, Missouri, which is shutting down the F/A-18E/F Super Hornet and EA-18G Growler production lines. Steve Parker, president and chief executive officer of Boeing Defense, Space & Security, said in a statement the company has made investments "in new facilities uniquely suited to build multiple products with next-generation capabilities, our dedicated and talented team is ready to execute this critical program." Currently designated the "F/A-XX" program, the new jet will be the centerpiece of the Navy's Next Generation Air Dominance family of systems. The jet "represents a crucial, non-negotiable investment in America’s national security and long-term air combat capabilities," Michael Duffey, the Pentagon's chief weapons buyer, said in a statement. Before winning the F-47 and F/A-XX contracts, Boeing had largely exited the fighter business, said Jeremiah Gertler, an aerospace expert at the Center for Strategic and International Studies. "What we don't know yet is how much F-47 DNA is in the F/A-XX. Are they being developed together or separately?" he said. Last year, the Pentagon tried to delay the contract due to concerns that the country's defense industry does not have enough engineering capacity to simultaneously develop two sixth-generation fighters. Democratic and Republican members of Congress from Missouri, which backed President Donald Trump in the last three elections, successfully pushed to continue funding the program. "With modernized systems and promising new capabilities, F/A-XX and F-47 production will create more opportunities to attract engineering and technology talent to Missouri," Senator Eric Schmitt, a Republican, said in a statement. The workers who assemble Boeing fighter jets went on strike for 101 days last year, returning to work without winning any concessions from the company. DELAYS AND CONGRESSIONAL INTERVENTION Still, the next-generation fighter jet has been buffeted by delays and funding disputes for years. Some Pentagon officials had sought to delay it by [USN:L1N3RL026 TEXT:"up to three years"], citing engineering and supply-chain capacity concerns, before Congress intervened, earmarking $750 million for the program in the 2025 tax-cut and spending law and an additional $1.4 billion in fiscal 2026. Lockheed Martin Corp (LMT.N) was [USN:S0N3OV0A2 TEXT:"eliminated"] from the competition in March 2025 after Navy officials determined its design had not met required criteria, leaving Boeing and Northrop as the finalists. With China rapidly fielding advanced combat aircraft, including designs Beijing describes as sixth-generation, the Navy has faced pressure to move quickly or risk operating without a modern carrier-based fighter in the 2030s and beyond. The new jet is expected to feature advanced stealth capabilities, improved range and endurance, and the ability to integrate with uncrewed combat aircraft and the Navy's carrier-based air defense systems. The Navy still plans to buy more than 270 Lockheed Martin F-35C jets for its carrier fleet, which will fly alongside the F/A-XX once it enters service. First production F/A-XX jets are expected in the 2030s, while the Super Hornet fleet, in service since the 1990s, is expected to remain flying into the 2040s.

item.title: Ceuta mass migrant crossing handling 'responsibility of all EU,' Spanish king says
item.description: European countries should have shown more solidarity and offered more support to Spain after the mass arrival in Ceuta of tens of thousands of migrants, Spanish King Felipe VI said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European countries should have shown more solidarity and offered more support to Spain after the mass arrival in Ceuta of tens of thousands of migrants, Spanish King Felipe VI said on Tuesday during a gala dinner to mark a visit by French President Emmanuel Macron. In an unusually outspoken address reflecting the depth of the crisis facing Spain following the Ceuta [USN:L8N43W1SU TEXT:"border rush"] that took place two months ago on Wednesday, the king said what happened in the enclave on the North African coast was "unacceptable" and generated an enormous security, public order and humanitarian challenge. "It's a situation that ought to have as a consequence a reinforcement of collaboration between member states in resources and cooperation," he said. "The European countries that suffer the most pressure from being on the external borders of the European Union cannot alone bear a responsibility that also belongs to everyone." The king spoke during a dinner at the Royal Palace in Madrid also attended by Spain's Socialist prime minister, Pedro Sanchez, a rare European proponent of the benefits of migration who launched a mass regularisation of irregular migrants that concluded in the summer. Sanchez, however, has proposed possible [USN:L8N45L09S TEXT:"changes"] to asylum rules to return arrivals more quickly, which NGOs and lawyers say would violate human rights conventions. Asked in a news conference about the plans, territorial policy minister Angel Victor Torres said the government was "analysing the possibility" of a legislative amendment but that it was "not easy" due to questions of international law. Following the mass crossing of 72,000 migrants into Ceuta on July 30, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen commended Spain's swift action in returning most arrivals to Morocco. Other leaders were less understanding, however, with Italy [USN:L8N43X2N1 TEXT:"suspending"] the European Union's border-free Schengen arrangements with Spain for one month. European Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner unveiled a [USN:L8N45L0QW TEXT:"plan"] on Tuesday to strengthen EU border controls in the wake of Ceuta. The plan, which requires the approval of member states, would strengthen the mandate of Frontex, the EU border protection agency, and give it a standing corps ready for immediate deployment.

item.title: US says two Indian nationals indicted in counterfeit Ozempic smuggling scheme
item.description: Two Indian nationals have been indicted by a US federal grand jury for allegedly smuggling and selling counterfeit Ozempic, the weight-loss drug, the Department of Justice said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two Indian nationals have been indicted by a US federal grand jury for allegedly smuggling and selling counterfeit Ozempic, the weight-loss drug, the Department of Justice said on Tuesday. One of the defendants, Swapnadip Roy, pleaded not guilty after being extradited from Italy while the other, Vicky Ramancha, remains at large, the department said. Between July 2023 and April 2024, Roy and Ramancha allegedly obtained counterfeit Ozempic in China and sold it to US distributors at discounted prices, it said. A legal representative for Roy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. One for Ramancha was not immediately available. The counterfeit medication included packaging, inserts and labels allegedly meant to convince purchasers that they were receiving authentic Ozempic, the popular weight-loss drug that can cost hundreds of dollars per month for patients. "The scheme continued even after the FDA seized some of the counterfeit Ozempic in December 2023 and issued a public warning regarding the products," the Justice Department said. Roy and Ramancha were charged with smuggling and selling counterfeit drugs, conspiracy to commit smuggling and to defraud the United States. They face up to 71 years in prison if convicted.

The company expects to direct much of its record spending this year toward AI compute infrastructure, solar cell-manufacturing capacity and a semiconductor fabrication project with SpaceX, as well as other expansion areas. item.title: Trump set to tout Korean investment in Alaska LNG, other projects, sources say
item.description: President Donald Trump could unveil plans as soon as Wednesday to tap South Korea's pledged strategic investment package for about $54 billion to build a liquefied natural gas facility in Alaska and several other major US projects, according to two people familiar with the discussions.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump could unveil plans as soon as Wednesday to tap South Korea's pledged strategic investment package for about $54 billion to build a liquefied natural gas facility in Alaska and several other major US projects, according to two people familiar with the discussions. The move would come as part of a flurry of economic and investment announcements ahead of November's midterm elections , as Trump seeks to bolster his administration's economic record to shore up voter support. Trump's overall approval rating sank to 32%, the lowest of his political career, according to a [USN:L6N43U101 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"] this month. Voters have expressed concern about the Iran war and high gasoline prices. Alaska has become a central stage for Republicans battling to maintain control of the US Senate, with many analysts regarding the contest there between incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola as a toss-up. A POTENTIAL SOURCE OF ENERGY FOR ASIA The Alaska LNG project would include a pipeline to transport natural gas from the North Slope to a liquefaction facility on the state's southern coast, where it could be shipped to Asian markets. It would be the first such US project with direct access to Asia, the fastest-growing market for liquefied natural gas. Before considering political needs or diplomatic demands, however, it was necessary to thoroughly verify the commercial rationale and viability of any investment that put a tremendous burden on the public, Kim Sung-won, a South Korean opposition lawmaker, told Reuters on Wednesday. "The U.S. investments should be structured in a mutually beneficial way that creates opportunities for South Korean companies, expand markets, and secures stable energy energy supply chains," said Kim of the People Power Party, briefed [USN:L1N45E006 TEXT:"last week"] by South Korea's industry ministry on the US plans. Kim, who chairs the South Korean parliament's trade committee, said the National Assembly would closely examine the profitability and fiscal risks of US investment projects, as well as tangible benefits for Korean companies. South Korean analysts and investors see the projects are "unbelievably unfair" for its government and companies, as Seoul would have to make investments alone but share profits with the United States, an analyst in Seoul told Reuters on condition of anonymity as the issue is a sensitive one. Japan's two biggest LNG importers, JERA and Tokyo Gas, have signed preliminary deals to buy a combined 2 million metric tons a year from Alaska LNG should it be built. Glenfarne, the project's developer, said in March it had lined up commitments for 13 million tons a year. To line up financing, it needed agreements for another 3 million tons and to make all commitments binding, the company said. Glenfarne could not immediately be reached for comment. Trump has repeatedly promoted the project as a way to expand US energy exports and strengthen ties with allies including South Korea and Japan. The project has faced years of uncertainty over its cost, financing and commercial viability, including in analysis by the South Korean and Japanese governments. Investment from Seoul would represent a potential source of financing for the project. South Korean and US officials have been working to identify projects for the $350-billion [USN:L1N45E040 TEXT:"strategic investment package"] that Seoul pledged under a trade deal last year. The two sides have discussed Alaska LNG, nuclear power and a gas-fired power project in Texas, among other potential investments. South Korea’s embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Seoul and Washington have been close allies since the 1950-53 Korean War, but there have been [USN:L4N44F04O TEXT:"tensions"] in recent months, with differences over trade and security cooperation and some sharp criticism of Seoul by Trump.

item.title: Austin Riley's clutch homer lifts Braves over Phillies in Game 1
item.description: ATLANTA -- Austin Riley's three-run homer capped a two-out rally in the eighth inning and lifted the Atlanta Braves to a 5-3 win over the Philadelphia Phillies in a back-and-forth opening game of the best-of-three National League wild-card series Tuesday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ATLANTA -- Austin Riley's three-run homer capped a two-out rally in the eighth inning and lifted the Atlanta Braves to a 5-3 win over the Philadelphia Phillies in a back-and-forth opening game of the best-of-three National League wild-card series Tuesday afternoon. After Michael Harris II singled and Ozzie Albies was hit by a pitch, Riley lifted the first pitch he saw from Phillies closer Jhoan Duran 385 feet to right-center, putting the Braves ahead with his sixth career postseason homer. "It felt good, no doubt," Riley said. "Just trying to get something over the plate. Duran is a really good pitcher. He's got some really good stuff." Riley posted career lows in batting average (.219), on-base percentage (.290) and slugging percentage (.364) during the regular season, but the eight-year veteran put those struggles behind him with one swing. "Everybody knows kind of how my season went; not the way I wanted it to," Riley said. "But that's the beauty of the postseason. You kind of get a clean slate and go out there and try to do something for the boys and for this city. It's definitely a good start." Duran (0-1), who converted 33 of 35 save opportunities in the regular season, retired the first five batters he faced before yielding the Braves' three-run uprising. "Any time you lose a game late, obviously it's frustrating," said Phillies interim manager Don Mattingly. "But in our minds, we had our best guy out there. You live with this one." Braves closer Raisel Iglesias allowed a leadoff single in the ninth, but he induced a 6-4-3 double play by Bryan De La Cruz and ended the game with a Bryson Stott flyout to record the save. Braves left-hander Dylan Lee (1-0) earned the win with a scoreless eighth. Harris was 3-for-3 and scored two runs for Atlanta, which has a chance on Wednesday afternoon to clinch its first postseason series win since the 2021 World Series. J.T. Realmuto delivered a two-out, two-run triple in the top of the seventh to give the Phillies a 3-2 lead. Alec Bohm contributed an RBI double for Philadelphia, which was held to six hits and went 1-for-5 with runners in scoring position. Braves starter Chris Sale was in line for the loss as he allowed two baserunners in the seventh before Didier Fuentes surrendered Realmuto's triple. Making his first postseason start since 2021, Sale struck out a playoff career-high nine. He gave up three runs on four hits and walked one over 6 1/3 innings. Phillies left-hander Jesus Luzardo -- making his first start in three weeks after a late-season stint on the injured list due to shoulder inflammation -- also delivered as the Game 1 starter. He allowed one run on three hits over five innings, striking out six and walking one. Bohm gave the Phillies the lead four batters into the game when he doubled into the left center gap to bring home Kyle Schwarber, who had walked. The Braves leveled the score in the second when Mike Yastrzemski rolled a seeing-eye single up the middle to plate Albies after Mauricio Dubon's leadoff double to left ignited the rally. In the sixth, Atlanta took advantage of Luzardo's exit. Albies' RBI triple to right center off Alex McFarlane drove in Harris to forge a 2-1 lead. --Curt Weiler, Field Level Media

item.title: トランプ氏、8.5兆円規模のアラスカLNG計画発表へ－中間選挙苦戦の中
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、韓国による約2000億ドル（約31兆4600億円）の対米投資計画を発表する見通しだ。この中には、長年停滞しているアラスカ産天然ガスの輸出を目指す事業への540億ドル（約8兆4900億円）の投資が含まれる。同事業は、再選を狙い接戦となっている共和党上院議員が推進してきた。

事情に詳しい複数の関係者が匿名を条件に明らかにしたところでは、今回発表される計画は、昨年の米韓貿易合意に基づき支援対象となる事業の第1弾となる。同合意には、3500億ドルの対米投資を行うとの約束が盛り込まれていた。関係者によると、トランプ氏は30日、大統領執務室で発表する見通しだ。

韓国の支援は、アラスカ州内を横断して天然ガスを輸送し、その大半をアジアの買い手に輸出する同事業の開発に不可欠となる公算が大きい。事情に詳しい関係者によれば、原子力事業を含む他のエネルギー事業にも韓国からの投資の一部が振り向けられる見通しだ。

非公開企業の米グレンファーン・グループがアラスカLNG事業を開発している。同事業はこれまでにLNG輸入業者と予備的な合意を結んでいるものの、最終投資決定には至っていない。同社はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

今回の発表の計画は、11月の中間選挙を前に、経済を巡る有権者の不満を背景に強い逆風に直面する共和党候補を後押しするため、トランプ氏が大統領としての権限と国際的なディール外交を活用する新たな事例となる。

アラスカ州選出の共和党のサリバン上院議員は、以前からアラスカLNG事業を強く支持。再選を目指して、民主党のペルトラ元下院議員と争っている。

関係者の話では、サリバン氏は30日の発表に合わせてホワイトハウスを訪れ、同州選出の共和党のベギッチ下院議員とダンリービー州知事も同席する予定。サリバン氏の事務所にコメントを要請したものの、返答は得られていない。

原題：Trump to Tout $54 Billion Alaska LNG Plan Amid Midterm Woes (1)（抜粋）

item.title: Trading Day: Stocks still in bonds' grip
item.description: US and world stocks slipped for a second day on Tuesday, pressured by elevated bond yields, and investor jitters around US inflation figures and potential quarter-end volatility on Wednesday. Bearish sentiment was tempered by falling oil prices.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
US and world [USN:L4N45L0MW TEXT:"stocks slipped"] for a second day on Tuesday, pressured by elevated bond yields, and investor jitters around US inflation figures and potential quarter-end volatility on Wednesday. Bearish sentiment was tempered by falling oil prices. In [USN:L6N45K13P TEXT:"my column today"], I look at the cracks that are beginning to appear in the AI financing edifice. Bonds issued to fund data center construction are coming under heavy pressure - but is this a warning of more turbulence ahead, or a 'buy' signal? Today's Key Reads [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"EXCLUSIVE-Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs"] [USN:L1N45K0VR TEXT:"Trump says working with Xi on AI would hurt US companies"] [USN:L6N45K107 TEXT:"'G force' driving world markets may need Fed and bond brake: Mike Dolan"] [USN:L1N45K0MU TEXT:"Battered bond market braces for a new era of interest rates"] [USN:P8N44P09G TEXT:"China unveils rate cut, mortgage subsidies to spur growth"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Japan -0.6%, [USN:L6N45L0EA TEXT:"Europe"] flat, [USN:L6N45L0IN TEXT:"UK"] -0.5%. Nasdaq -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.2%, Dow -0.3%. SECTORS/SHARES: Seven sectors on the S&P 500 fall, four rise. Energy -0.9%, utilities +1.1%. US chip sector +1.3%. [USN:L4N45L1G6 TEXT:"Apple"] biggest loser on the Dow, -2.7%. [USN:L6N45L0TG TEXT:"Carnival"] biggest gainer on the S&P 500, +13%. FX: [USN:L4N45L03Z TEXT:"Dollar"] +0.3%, strongest in 2 months. Aussie dollar -0.7% after [USN:P8N3X1041 TEXT:"RBA"] hike, Norwegian krone -1%. BONDS: Selloff pauses in UK and Europe, although French-German spread posts widest close in 14 years. US 30-year yield 5.62%, highest since 2002. Entire US curve within 5 bps of trading above 5%. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N45K1PF TEXT:"Oil"] -2.5%, [USN:L4N45L01H TEXT:"gold"] +1% .

Today's Talking Points: Anthropicology The [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"Reuters exclusive"] report on Anthropic's propsoed IPO makes for fascinating reading. The AI giant's revenue grew 12-fold last year, but losses exceeded $8 billion on an operating basis and more than $40 billion on a net basis, according to the prospectus documents for a prospective IPO that is targeting a valuation of more than $2 trillion. Essentially, the company is spending big, and losing money. Or it has been until now. The hope is that revenues continue to grow at an ever-increasing rate, overtaking the huge spend, and justifying the eye-popping IPO [USN:L4N45L180 TEXT:"valuation"]. But the threat of cheaper Chinese models looms large. Anthropic's costs and investment outlays mean it might struggle in a price war, if it comes to that. Consumer blues It's a conundrum. The US economy is expanding at an annual pace of around 8% to 9% in nominal terms, and the unemployment rate is 4.1%, a historically low rate essentially reflecting full employment. Yet Americans are gloomier than they have been in years. [USN:AQN2MLCVJ TEXT:"Consumer confidence"] slumped this month to the lowest since 2014, and are more insecure about the jobs market than they have been in more than five years. What gives? Consumer confidence has for years been a poor leading indicator of consumer behavior, and by extension, wider economic growth. Spending has held up, thanks to robust spending by the wealthy, growth is strong and corporate profits and stock prices have never been higher. Maybe a "mean reversion" is overdue? No quarter given A tumultuous third quarter draws to a close on Wednesday, a three-month period that saw, in no particular order: a 40% rebound in oil, record US diesel prices, the biggest quarterly slump in corporate bonds since 2022, a crashing wave of AI "doomerism," the Fed raise interest rates and US and global government bond yields hit their highest in 20 years. Oh, and in among all that, stocks hit record highs. It will be difficult for the fourth quarter to be as seismic, but investors should buckle up. Worries over AI - financial, and its existential threat to humanity - are only likely to deepen; the Fed is on track to continue its tightening cycle; US midterm elections are looming; and the US war on Iran is still raging. Can equities shrug all that off again? The third-quarter earnings season that kicks into gear in the next few weeks will be revealing. What could move markets tomorrow? Japan retail sales (August) China 'official' PMIs (September) Germany CPI inflation (September, prelim) US GDP (Q2, final) US PCE inflation (August) Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: Inside McDonald’s push to have AI price its menus
item.description: NEW YORK: McDonald’s is increasingly using artificial intelligence to guide menu prices across the United States and some global markets, a plan that aims to boost headquarters’ profit but risks alienating customers and attracting antitrust scrutiny. One pricing factor supercharged by AI: an estimate
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Inside McDonald’s push to have AI price its menus

McDonald's drive through signs in New York City, US, on Jul 30, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Jordan Tovin)

30 Sep 2026 04:59AM (Updated: 30 Sep 2026 10:05AM)

FAST

NEW YORK: McDonald’s is increasingly using artificial intelligence to guide menu prices across the United States and some global markets, a plan that aims to boost headquarters’ profit but risks alienating customers and attracting antitrust scrutiny.  One pricing factor supercharged by AI: an estimate of how much each store's patrons are willing to pay. The details of how that pricing system works, its extensive use of AI, the company’s regulatory concerns and the tensions with its franchisees have not been previously reported.  Reuters reviewed screenshots of the company's pricing engine taken in August and interviewed nine sources with first-hand knowledge of the burger chain’s strategy.

McDonald’s pricing engine uses machine-learning algorithms to continually analyse data from millions of daily transactions across McDonald’s nearly 14,000 restaurants and generate what the company calls “the optimal price” at each location for each menu item, from Big Macs to discounted coffee for seniors. The engine has widened existing price differences for the same product between restaurants, including from neighbourhood to neighbourhood within the same area, three franchisees told Reuters.  Screenshots of the interface franchisees use, reviewed by Reuters, show messages including: “Your restaurant is showing MEDIUM SENSITIVITY to Price” based in part on “customer willingness to pay in your area”.  The platform also contains public price information pulled from online menus of nearby restaurants of competitors, including Wendy’s and Burger King. Those chains said they do not use AI in pricing decisions.

Also read:

Trump, AI CEOs sign voluntary safety pact, back data centre expansion

India was late to the AI chip race. Could cameras and cars offer a way in?

A Reuters check of prices in September on the McDonald’s mobile app showed price differences. For example, a company-run store in Fresno, California sells a Big Mac for US$5.69, but another company-run restaurant two miles away sells the same sandwich for US$6.89, a 21 per cent premium. Reuters could not confirm if the price difference is the result of the price engine’s recommendations or other factors.  McDonald’s says its franchisees are free to set their own prices, but five store owners told Reuters the company pressured them to use the AI-pricing tools.  A franchisee document from June reviewed by Reuters shows McDonald’s records franchisees’ deviations from the recommendations in detail.  In January, McDonald’s started requiring franchisees to be “constructively engaging with McDonald’s approved Pricing Consultant and Tools” as part of its new business standards, according to an internal communication sent to franchisees and reviewed by Reuters. McDonald’s said in a statement costs and other factors vary across its stores, and that restaurants even a few miles apart can belong to distinct markets. Its pricing portal is “a tool, not a mandate, designed to provide restaurant-specific recommendations to help franchisees deliver value for customers and make informed business decisions”, McDonald's said.  The company also described Reuters reporting as “speculative and uninformed” claims that “attempt to recast a standard business practice as something controversial”.  Other fast food companies are turning to AI to help with pricing and other operations, including Yum Brands, the world’s largest restaurant company by location count, which owns the KFC and Taco Bell brands. Yum did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a meeting with investors on Wednesday, McDonald's said its "industry-leading" pricing engine was important to a larger corporate bet on affordability, and that franchisees see the need for inexpensive menu items to lure low-income consumers.

Also read:

AI is creating an economy that can grow without needing more workers. Should we be worried?

McDonald's deeper push into AI pricing has potential regulatory and reputational risks.  Other consumer companies have faced swift public backlash after disclosures that they may use algorithms to price the same product differently.  Wendy’s endured a wave of criticism over the potential for unfair price fluctuations in 2024 after its CEO announced plans to test “dynamic pricing”.  Wendy’s said its comments were misconstrued and told Reuters it did not implement the system. Instacart in December ended its use of AI tools that showed different grocery prices to different shoppers in a limited test, after a study disclosing the practice sparked criticism from consumers and lawmakers.  Instacart said it will never use personal information to determine item prices.  “It’s in the interest of the company to know where there’s (customer) demand and to get that feedback in real time,” said Brooklyn resident Diane Bezucha. But if that technology is used to raise prices simply because of more demand, “that doesn’t really help me as a customer”. As the use of AI becomes more widely adopted, US courts and regulators are scrutinising whether certain algorithmic pricing practices can facilitate illegal coordination between competitors – which franchisees are sometimes considered. McDonald’s cautions that franchisees accessing its pricing engine portal risk scrutiny related to antitrust prohibitions because its restaurant owners “may be competitors”, according to screenshots of the legal terms for the portal Reuters reviewed in August.

Also read:

How AI ‘world models’ are helping robots learn to adapt in the real world

THE MAKING OF A US$18 BIG MAC In 2023, McDonald’s CEO Chris Kempczinski told investors that McDonald’s had developed proprietary tools to evaluate pricing at individual restaurants.  That same year, the pricing tools suggested to Connecticut franchisee George Michell that he charge about US$18 for a Big Mac meal sold off a state turnpike, according to the restaurant owner’s lawsuit alleging that the brand tried to push him out of the franchisee system for discriminatory reasons. Reuters could not independently establish what the tool recommended to Michell.  McDonald’s has disputed the lawsuit and said Michell repeatedly breached his franchise agreements. Although the price went viral and sparked widespread consumer outrage, the price “caused no loss of sales” at the restaurant, according to a filing from the franchisee in December. The case is ongoing, but courts have dismissed claims related to McDonald’s breach of contract.  Some franchisees say the engine recommended large price increases during the pandemic and afterwards, as inflation soared.  But in recent months the engine has pushed more conservative pricing – including some decreases – causing friction between franchisees and corporate headquarters. McDonald’s has used some form of an AI pricing tool since at least 2019. Pushing lower prices to attract more customers and lift sales can boost the corporation’s bottom line because the headquarters makes the vast majority of its money from taking a percentage of its franchisees’ total revenue – regardless of individual-store profit margins.  Franchisees, by contrast, have stronger incentives to raise prices to help cover the rising wages, rent and other restaurant expenses, which are up 36 per cent since 2019, the National Restaurant Association estimates. Despite the engine’s consumer-friendly push for more conservative pricing, US foot traffic at McDonald's has declined year-over-year for every complete month since March, according to estimates from data analytics firm Placer.ai.  MCDONALD’S TRACKS "PRICING NON-COMPLIANCE" BY FRANCHISEES McDonald’s sends AI pricing guidance to franchisees at least three times a year, company documents show. One former franchisee said she did not feel compelled to take the prices but five others described various forms of pressure from the company to use them.  Karen King – a former store owner who retired from the franchise system last summer – and other franchisees described phone calls from corporate officers to discuss pricing when they strayed from those recommendations.  “You don’t really have much of a choice anymore” about pricing, King said. McDonald’s did not address her specific claims.  McDonald’s has power over decisions that can make or break a franchisee’s business, such as their eligibility to renew or open new stores.  CEO Kempczinski told investors in August that, because of recent changes to the way the company conducts business reviews of its franchisees, “pricing non-compliance in certain cases is part of those conversations”. At the same time, the company also warns the system may create potential legal risk for owners. The pricing portal’s terms of service warn that owners “may be competitors of each other” and therefore “it is particularly important for all Users of the Tool to understand and comply fully with anti-trust and competition laws”.  The terms say that for additional guidance, franchisees should consult with their own attorneys. The document also says franchisees are “always free to determine the final price”. Reuters reviewed the pricing portal’s terms of service in August.  That language is “an acknowledgment there’s a potential problem” given recent scrutiny of pricing algorithms by the Federal Trade Commission and other antitrust regulators over collusion concerns, said William Kovacic, director of the competition law center at George Washington University and a former commissioner of the Federal Trade Commission appointed by Republican President George W Bush. Other experts countered that the legal and regulatory risk to McDonald’s is low because the competitors are franchisees, and courts in recent decades have given wide latitude for brands to exert control over their franchisees' pricing.  McDonald’s said in a statement it takes antitrust compliance seriously and that the guidance in its terms of service is not evidence of anticompetitive behavior. The FTC and the US Department of Justice, which also enforces antitrust regulations, did not respond to a request for comment.  HOLDING THE LINE ON SUMMER ICE CREAM PRICES McDonald’s influences the pricing engine’s recommendations by working closely with Tiger Analytics, which runs the AI platform, according to two former Tiger employees.  The former employees said McDonald’s regularly provided rules and corporate targets, such as attracting more customers or boosting profits. Tiger declined to comment on its work for McDonald’s. Examples of McDonald’s parameters for the price engine included, according to the two employees: focusing increases on menu items that have not had a price increase in at least two years; only increasing prices on items that have had recent price increases in at least 30 per cent of stores; excluding ice creams and drinks from price increases during summer months.  Some franchisees, facing rising costs, resist such guidance. At the company’s August earnings call, CEO Kempczinski called out store owners who did not comply with the chain’s under-US$3 menu pricing guidance – about a third of total franchisees. He said their “business results (were) a lot softer” without disclosing how the company reached that conclusion.

Source: Reuters/rl

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、米金利高が支援 対ユーロで16カ月ぶり高値
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２９日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場で、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、対ユーロと対スイスフランで...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、米金利高が支援　対ユーロで16カ月ぶり高値 5:54 配信

２０１１年１１月撮影　 REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　２９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場で、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、対ユーロと対スイスフランで１年４カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げに動くか見極めようと一連の米経済指標が注目される中、米国債利回りが数年ぶりの高水準近辺で推移していることがドルの下支えになっている。

ドル／円はほぼ横ばいの１５７．３０円近辺。片山さつき財務相は２９日の閣議後会見で、今後の為替政策について「引き続き日米当局の間で緊密なコミュニケーションを維持し、秩序ある為替市場の維持に取り組む」と発言。市場では日米の協調介入の可能性を探る動きが出ている。

ユーロに対しては世界的なエネルギーショックのほか、欧州の政治リスクの高まりが重石になっており、ユーロ／ドル は一時１．１３１２ドルと、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。終盤の取引では０．２６％安の１．１３４１ドル。

この日は米１０年債利回りが２００７年６月以来の高水準を付け、５％を上回って推移。ドル相場を下支えした。コーペイのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、カール・シャモッタ氏は「金利差の拡大が為替市場の主な動意になる中、ドルは主要通貨全般に対して上昇している」と指摘。マネーコープのトレーディング・ストラクチャード商品部門責任者、ユージン・エプスタイン氏は「現在は個々の経済指標を見極めている段階だ」とし、「雇用と物価の指標を精査し、ＦＲＢ当局者が示唆しているタカ派姿勢が正当化されるか判断しようとしている」と述べた。

連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者の間では、バー理事がＦＲＢが目標とする２％のインフレ率に向けた進展が「軌道から外れた」とし、追加利上げの必要性を改めて訴えた。一方、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は、ＦＲＢは９月の会合で利上げを決定したため、現在は性急に行動する必要はないとの考えを示し、今後発表される経済指標を見極めてから次の対応を決定することで経済がどのような状況にあるのかより明確に把握できると発言。１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣでの追加利上げ観測の後退につながった。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．１７％高の０．８３４フラン。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．２％高の１０１．４０と、７月２８日以来の水準を更新した。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.28/157.31

始値 157.20

高値 157.69

安値 156.99

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1340/1.1344

始値 1.1348

高値 1.1358

安値 1.1313

item.title: Anthropic IPO prospectus lays bare deep dependence on Big Tech partners
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows how much it depends on a small group of customers and tech giants, highlighting key risks for the AI developer as it asks investors to back its ambitious, capital-intensive plan that it says will transform the global economy.
item.dc:creator: Echo Wang, Krystal Hu
item.content:encoded: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows how much it depends on a small group of customers and tech giants, highlighting key risks for the AI developer as it asks investors to back its [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"ambitious, capital-intensive plan"] that it says will transform the global economy. The company routed 47% of its sales to customers last year through cloud partners Amazon (AMZN.O) and Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, according to a copy of its confidential IPO filing seen by Reuters. Those two companies, which are supercharging the AI developer's distribution and collecting customer bills on its behalf, are also big Anthropic investors, critical suppliers of computing power and direct rivals in AI . Amazon declined to comment. Anthropic and Alphabet did not respond to requests seeking comment. The filing offers a rare look inside a business that barely existed several years ago but is growing at breakneck speed due to its role as a key developer of large-language AI models. Anthropic is seeking a valuation of about $2 trillion and has plans to spend hundreds of billions in the coming years to accelerate its growth. Revenue surged 12-fold in 2025 to nearly $4.6 billion, while operating losses more than doubled to top $8 billion, [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"Reuters reported exclusively"] on Monday. The US accounted for nearly two-thirds of total sales. About $3.8 billion in Anthropic's revenue came from customers paying based on how much they use the company's Claude AI system, while subscription revenue came to $789 million. Anthropic said it expects consumption-based revenue to account for "the substantial majority" of its revenue for the foreseeable future. REVENUE CONCENTRATION GROWS Sales through the cloud marketplaces totaled about $2.16 billion, or 47% of Anthropic's annual revenue in 2025, the filing shows. The company paid roughly $351 million back to the platforms in distribution fees, according to a Reuters analysis, suggesting the cloud providers collected some 16 cents for every dollar of those sales. Anthropic reports channel partner fees within the "sales, marketing, and partnerships" operating expense line item on its financial statements. The fees are one strand of an increasingly circular financial relationship. Amazon and Google have invested tens of billions of dollars in Anthropic, while the AI developer has made enormous commitments to buy computing capacity. At the end of 2025, Anthropic had $54.6 billion in non-cancellable hosting and computing commitments. By early 2026, its total long-term [USN:L1N45K0RM TEXT:"commitments exceeded $417 billion"], covering 3.5 gigawatts of dedicated computing capacity. Anthropic, in its prospectus, framed these relationships as an advantage. It said that by offering its Claude AI model through Amazon, Google and Microsoft's (MSFT.O) cloud platforms, it can tap their vast sales networks and reach customers already using their services, accelerating "market penetration at a scale we believe would be difficult for any single organization to directly replicate." But the company also acknowledged that its reliance on a limited number of partners and suppliers "creates complex dynamics that could give rise to conflicts of interest and adversely affect our access to compute." The company signed a cloud computing deal with Microsoft in November. The cloud providers also gain visibility into Anthropic's pricing and commercial terms, which could influence their decisions on compute allocation and how aggressively they sell its products, the filing said. The cloud companies are also Anthropic's customers, it noted. Anthropic's dependence on Amazon and Google has grown as its revenue soared. Sales through the two companies rose from 11% of revenue in 2023 to 32% in 2024, and nearly half last year. The company's cash collection is also increasingly funneled through these third parties, which were responsible for collecting 60% of the $909 million in customer bills outstanding at the end of 2025, up from 42% in 2024. Anthropic warned that disputes or delays in that pipeline could hurt cash flow even though it contracts directly with the customers. Its customer base is also concentrated, as two unnamed customers each generated 12% of revenue last year. Anthropic warned that many of its biggest customers are not bound by long-term contracts and could reduce or halt spending. The cloud relationships have also complicated financial comparisons with rival OpenAI. Anthropic books the full value of marketplace contracts — sales agreements where customers buy access to Claude through a cloud provider's marketplace — as revenue because it sets prices and delivers the service, while recording the platforms' cut as a marketing cost. OpenAI has told investors and employees this approach [USN:L6N42D13P TEXT:"inflates Anthropic's reported revenue"] by billions of dollars, Reuters reported in June. Anthropic told Reuters then that it follows established accounting practices, recognizing gross revenue because it is the “principal” in the transaction.

item.title: Exclusive-Anthropic IPO prospectus lays bare deep dependence on Big Tech partners
item.description: Sept 29 : Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows how much it depends on a small group of customers and tech giants, highlighting key risks for the AI developer as it asks investors to back its ambitious, capital-intensive plan that it says will transform the global economy.The company routed 47 per cent of its sale
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
